items.title_zh: 阿里拟推5万亿至10万亿参数超大模型 并发布新一代自研AI芯片
items.title_en: Alibaba Plans 5T-10T Parameter Mega Model, Releases New Self-Developed AI Chip
items.summary_zh: 阿里拟推5万亿至10万亿参数超大模型 并发布新一代自研AI芯片 cnBeta.COM
items.summary_en: Alibaba reportedly plans to launch an ultra-large model with 5 trillion to 10 trillion parameters and unveil a new generation of self-developed AI chips, according to cnBeta. Details on timing and performance were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 若成真，将刷新国产大模型参数规模，并强化阿里在自研算力芯片上的自主能力。
items.why_en: If realized, it would set a new scale for domestic large models and strengthen Alibaba's self-reliance in AI chips.

items.title_zh: 阿里平头哥首次公布 CPU 规划：将推倚天 720、730、750 三代芯片，单核性能持续提升
items.title_en: Alibaba's T-Head Unveils CPU Roadmap: Yitian 720, 730 and 750 Server Chips
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 22 日消息，阿里巴巴“2026 云栖大会”于 9 月 22 日-24 日在杭州举行，IT之家亲临现场，将为大家持续带来相关报道。 除了真武 V900 之外，阿里今天上午还首次公布了平头哥倚天服务器 CPU 的规划 ——2027 年 Q3 将推出倚天 720 和倚天 730 两代服务器 CPU。 据介绍，倚天 720 将实现单核性能、核密度与能效的全面提升；倚天 730 将首次基于平头哥全自研 CPU 微架构设计，单核 SPECint2017/GHz 性能将最高提升至倚天 710 的 1.4 倍。 平头哥透露，未来几年将持续升级自研 CPU 微架构，基于第二代自研核的倚天 750，将支持平头哥自研 ICN 片间互联总线协议，倚天 CPU 与真武 AI 芯片之间可通过 ICN 总线直接互联，进一步提升 CPU 与 AI 芯片的协同效率。 目前，平头哥已推出真武系列 AI 芯片、倚天系列服务器 CPU、ICNSwitch 互联芯片、磐脉系列智能网卡、镇岳系列存储主控芯片等数据中心核心芯片，实现算力、网力和存力的全栈自研，并实现全栈高效协同，为广泛的 AI 场景提供强大算力。 相关阅读： 《 最强国产 AI 芯片阿里平头哥真武 V900 发布，全新磐久超节点服务器明年 Q1 上市 》 《 阿里平头哥将发布最强国产 AI 芯片真武 V900，算力提升 2 倍 》
items.summary_en: At the 2026 Yunqi Conference, Alibaba's chip unit T-Head published its Yitian server CPU roadmap for the first time, saying Yitian 720 and 730 will arrive in Q3 2027. Yitian 720 promises gains in single-core performance, core density and energy efficiency, while Yitian 730 is the first built on T-Head's fully in-house CPU microarchitecture with up to 1.4x the SPECint2017/GHz single-core performance of Yitian 710. A later Yitian 750, based on a second-generation in-house core, will support T-Head's ICN die-to-die interconnect so Yitian CPUs can link directly with Zhenwu AI chips.
items.why_zh: 这是阿里首次系统披露自研服务器 CPU 的多年路线图，并明确 CPU 与自研 AI 芯片的总线级协同，反映国产数据中心芯片走向全栈自研。
items.why_en: It is Alibaba's first systematic multi-year roadmap for in-house server CPUs, and its direct CPU-to-AI-chip interconnect signals a push toward a fully self-developed domestic data-center chip stack.

items.title_zh: 曝阿里试水千问平板 QwenBook：定位原生智能体电脑，主打办公、打通 WPS
items.title_en: Alibaba Reportedly Tests QwenBook 'Qwen Tablet', an Agent-Native Computer for Office Work
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 22 日消息，据《晚点 LatePost》今日报道，阿里云旗下无影团队正在研发一款名叫 QwenBook 的 AI 设备 ，定位是原生智能体电脑，但产品形态更接近一台“千问平板”，产品定义和硬件部分由团队自研，无影过去做云电脑积累的系统和端云能力，也被带进了这个项目。 一位阿里云人士称，QwenBook 是一款仍处于早期的试水产品， 主打办公 ，目前，产品接入的模型包括 Qwen3.8-Max 和 Qwen3.8-Flash。 报道还提到，QwenBook 团队目前约 150 人，系统团队主要基于无影和阿里云 OS 团队重新组建，硬件团队招聘了不少头部手机厂商的人。一位阿里云人士表示， QwenBook 在今年 4 月份左右启动，晚于第一代豆包手机的发布 。 QwenBook 目前展示的系统级能力，首先建立在一套自有应用上。团队做了一套自己可控的工具，用户能直接使用，包括系统级听记、Wiki、智能文件夹、自研邮箱，以及知识库 MyNote 和记忆管理应用 MyZone。此外， QwenBook 在和金山深度合作，将会打通 WPS，目前还在开发阶段 。 报道还称，该团队计划在云栖大会上展示的是一款 QwenBook 演示版本，该版本只透出了部分功能，主要用于呈现千问平板的产品理念，并非内部的最新完整版本。 完整产品预计要到今年底或明年初才能发布 。 IT之家注意到，…
items.summary_en: According to LatePost, Alibaba Cloud's Wuying team is developing an AI device called QwenBook, positioned as an agent-native computer but closer in form to a 'Qwen tablet.' Still an early-stage experiment focused on office work, it runs Qwen3.8-Max and Qwen3.8-Flash, with a roughly 150-person team and system-level tools such as meeting notes, Wiki, smart folders, a self-built mail service and memory apps MyNote and MyZone, plus a WPS integration with Kingsoft under development. A partial demo was shown at the Yunqi Conference, with the full product expected late this year or early next.
items.why_zh: 若成型，这将是阿里把大模型 Agent 能力做进自有终端硬件的一次关键试水，也意味着其与手机厂商、PC 厂商在 AI 终端上正面竞争。
items.why_en: If realized, it would mark Alibaba's key bet on putting agentic AI into its own hardware, pitting it directly against AI phone and PC makers.

items.title_zh: 「AI新世代」“数据上传”风波后，智谱接连上线补救措施，AI数据安全再敲警钟
items.title_en: After Data-Upload Controversy, Zhipu Rolls Out Remedial Measures as AI Data Security Concerns Grow
items.summary_zh: 「AI新世代」“数据上传”风波后，智谱接连上线补救措施，AI数据安全再敲警钟 新浪财经
items.summary_en: Sina Finance reports that Zhipu has rolled out a series of remedial measures following a data-upload controversy, once again drawing attention to AI data security. No further details were disclosed, but the episode highlights the compliance, privacy and trust pressures facing large-model companies over how user data is used.
items.why_zh: 事件再次提示，数据安全与用户隐私处理正在成为大模型产品能否持续运营的关键合规底线。
items.why_en: It underscores that data security and user-privacy handling are becoming a make-or-break compliance baseline for large-model products.

items.title_zh: 行业首个系统级 Agent Harness 架构：“千问手机”荣耀 Magic9 系列首发搭载阿里 Qwen Intelligence，9 月 28 日发布
items.title_en: First System-Level Agent Harness: Honor Magic9 Series to Debut Alibaba's Qwen Intelligence
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 22 日消息，阿里巴巴“2026 云栖大会”于 9 月 22 日-24 日在杭州举行，IT之家亲临现场，将为大家持续带来相关报道。 今日，阿里宣布推出 AI 手机全栈解决方案 Qwen Intelligence。据透露，将于 9 月 28 日发布的荣耀 Magic9 系列将成为首批搭载该方案的正式机型。除此之外， 荣耀 Robot Phone 也将提供支持。 阿里介绍称，Qwen Intelligence 专为手机场景深度优化，为合作伙伴提供基于千问大模型的 Agent 技术平台，让手机能够更可靠地完成跨应用的复杂任务。荣耀 Robot Phone 也同步支持该方案。 双方合作可追溯至 2026 年 7 月。在 2026 世界人工智能大会期间，阿里巴巴宣布联合荣耀基于千问大模型共创面向手机场景的解决方案，该方案已在荣耀 Robot Phone 落地。此次发布的 Qwen Intelligence 是双方合作的进一步深化。 基于 Qwen Intelligence 与荣耀MagicOS，双方共同打造了面向下一代 AI 手机的垂域模型和解决方案。荣耀 CEO 李健此前介绍，新一代 YOYO 可执行的超长任务步数已达到 100 步以上，综合意图理解处理能力达到 91.8%，复杂任务准确率 87%，任务整体执行闭环率达到 90%。系统内置 700 个工具，兼容 500 个…
items.summary_en: At the 2026 Yunqi Conference, Alibaba launched Qwen Intelligence, a full-stack AI phone solution, with the Honor Magic9 series launching September 28 as the first official models to carry it; Honor's Robot Phone is also supported. Built on the Qwen model family, the platform gives partners agent capabilities so phones can reliably complete complex cross-app tasks, and is billed as the industry's first system-level Agent Harness architecture. The launch deepens a partnership that began at WAIC 2026, with Honor CEO Li Jian citing YOYO's 100-plus-step long tasks, 91.8% intent understanding, 87% complex-task accuracy and 90% closed-loop execution rate.
items.why_zh: 大模型公司首次把系统级 Agent Harness 架构搬上手机，标志着端侧 AI 竞争从模型能力转向系统级任务执行与生态整合。
items.why_en: It marks the first time a model company has put a system-level Agent Harness on phones, shifting on-device AI competition from raw model capability to system-level task execution and ecosystem integration.

items.title_zh: 价值的几何：用任务向量组合实现语言模型的伦理偏好对齐
items.title_en: Geometry of Values: Task Vector Composition for Ethical Preference Alignment in Language Models
items.summary_zh: 该论文关注大模型在价值冲突场景下的隐性偏见与跨语言指令遵循的脆弱性，构建了一个包含 12,000 个二选一道德困境实例的数据集，覆盖三组两两价值冲突：诚实 vs 正义、正义 vs 自主、自主 vs 诚实，并把这些样本翻译成印地语、阿拉伯语、西班牙语和中文以考察跨语言行为。在 GPT-5-mini 上的基准测试显示，模型一贯偏向诚实这一取向。论文据此提出以任务向量组合的方式，对语言模型进行伦理偏好对齐，探索价值取向的几何化调控路径。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21094v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in applications that must weigh clashing moral values, yet even strong models exhibit hidden biases and brittle instruction-following across languages. We introduce a 12,000-instance dataset of two-option dilemmas covering pairwise three value conflicts: Honesty vs. Justice, Justice vs. Autonomy, and Autonomy vs. Honesty, along with their translations into Hindi, Arabic, Spanish, and Chinese, to probe cross-lingual behavior. Benchmarking on GPT-5-mini reveals that it consistently favors Hon…
items.why_zh: 它为衡量和调控大模型在多语言、价值冲突情境下的伦理偏好提供了可复用的数据集与方法，对对齐研究有直接参考价值。
items.why_en: It offers a reusable dataset and method for measuring and steering LLM ethical preferences across languages and conflicting values, directly informing alignment research.

items.title_zh: 从代码归档到知识图谱：打通 Software Heritage、COAR Notify 与 Wikidata
items.title_en: From Code Archival to Knowledge Graph: Bridging Software Heritage, COAR Notify and Wikidata
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，软件已是一等科研对象，但源码与学术记录之间经过验证的关联在 Linked Open Data（LOD）云中仍基本缺失，使已归档的软件制品与语义发现相互隔离。为此，作者提出一条端到端的对账流水线，从论文与源码链接明确且经编辑核验的来源采集、验证并建模“论文—代码仓库”配对，这些来源包括以软件为中心的期刊 JOSS、SoftwareX、IPOL，以及可复现性报告等。该工作旨在衔接 Software Heritage、COAR Notify 与 Wikidata，让代码归档更顺畅地进入开放知识图谱。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21667v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Software is a first-class scientific object, yet validated links between source code and the scholarly record remain largely absent from the Linked Open Data (LOD) cloud, isolating archived artefacts from semantic discovery. This paper presents an end-to-end reconciliation pipeline that harvests, validates, and models publication-to-repository pairs from sources where the link between a paper and its source code is explicit and editorially verified: the software-centric journals JOSS, SoftwareX, and IPOL, together with the reproducibility repor…
items.why_zh: 它试图让代码与论文的关联成为可查询的开放数据，从而提升科研软件的可见性、可引用性与可复现性。
items.why_en: It aims to make code-to-publication links queryable open data, improving the visibility, citability and reproducibility of research software.

items.title_zh: Bad Genius：用反事实引导的 Harness 演化摆脱任务特定捷径
items.title_en: Bad Genius: Counterfactual-Guided Harness Evolution Beyond Task-Specific Shortcuts
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，自动 harness 优化会损害智能体评测的可靠性：一个 Proposer 会反复利用已发布的基准 B_rel 来改写固定目标智能体周边的提示、记忆、检索、工具与控制代码。由于任务留出只改变语义任务、却固定基准协议，一个“坏天才”式的 Proposer 可能演化出依赖基准级捷径的作弊 harness，其在已发布基准上的收益并非真实能力提升。为此作者提出 Counterfactual Harness Search and Evolution（CHASE），把 harness 演化重新表述为反事实引导的搜索与演化过程，以抑制任务特定捷径、提升评测的可信度。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.18366v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Reliable agent evaluation is complicated by automatic harness optimization, which repeatedly uses a released benchmark $B_{\mathrm{rel}}$ to guide a Proposer that edits prompts, memory, retrieval, tools, and control code around a fixed target agent. Task holdout varies semantic tasks but leaves the benchmark protocol fixed, so a "bad genius" Proposer can produce a cheating harness whose released-benchmark gain depends on a benchmark-wide shortcut. We introduce Counterfactual Harness Search and Evolution (CHASE), which casts harness evolution…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了基准驱动的自动优化可能被“钻空子”，为智能体评测的可信度问题提供了检测与缓解思路。
items.why_en: It exposes how benchmark-driven automatic optimization can be gamed, offering a way to detect and mitigate credibility problems in agent evaluation.

items.title_zh: 固定规划器下的技能模块演化：长期运行机器人系统的版本管理、回滚与运行时治理
items.title_en: Evolving Skill Modules under a Fixed Planner: Versioning, Rollback, and Runtime Governance for Long-Lived Robot Systems
items.summary_zh: 论文把长期部署机器人的技能持续升级视为一个软件生命周期问题：固定的决策层负责调度带版本的技能模块，运行时层则对每个动作进行筛查。作者在六个 robosuite 任务上报告了三项负面结果与两项测量：其一，峰值任务成功率在不同随机种子间极不稳定，同一方法内部跨度达 23.3% 至 73.3%，因此单次运行的峰值不能用来给方法排序；其二，系统中的四个模块均属整任务策略。这些发现指向长期运行机器人系统在版本化、回滚与运行时治理方面的实际困难。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2604.07799v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Robots deployed for long periods keep improving their skills, and each update changes a released system. We treat this as a software-lifecycle problem: a fixed decision layer dispatches versioned skill modules and a runtime layer was built to screen each action. On six robosuite tasks we report three negative results and two measurements. First, peak task success is unstable across random seeds (within one method it spans 23.3 to 73.3%), so single-run peaks cannot rank these methods. Second, the system's four modules are whole-task poli…
items.why_zh: 它把机器人技能迭代纳入版本化与运行时治理的工程视角，并警示基于单次峰值成功率的评测结论并不可靠。
items.why_en: It frames robot skill updates as a versioning and runtime-governance engineering problem, and warns that evaluation conclusions based on single-run peak success rates are unreliable.

items.title_zh: 从瞬时情绪推断到持续情绪支持：陪伴智能体的纵向研究评估
items.title_en: From Momentary Emotion Inference to Sustained Emotion Support: Evaluating a Companion Agent in a Longitudinal Study
items.summary_zh: 生成式智能体已被证明能提供瞬时的情绪支持，但这种能力能否在长时间跨度上持续，仍不清楚。研究团队部署了基于情绪调节理论的陪伴智能体 PAIR，19 名参与者连续使用 14 天，共产生 1,093 次会话。研究者把系统给出的情绪估计与用户在引导前后的自我报告配对，并结合日志与访谈进行分析。初步结果显示情绪估算与用户自评之间存在对应关系；论文摘要在此处被截断，完整的长期支持结论尚未呈现。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.16344v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Sustained emotional support is a long-horizon interaction task closely tied to human well-being. Recent research demonstrates generative agents' capacity for momentary emotional support, yet how these capabilities sustain support over time remains unclear. To examine this challenge, we deployed PAIR, a theory-based emotion-regulation companion, with 19 participants for 14 days. Across 1,093 sessions, we paired emotion estimates with self-reports before and after guidance and analyzed logs and interviews. Estimates corresponded more clos…
items.why_zh: 情绪陪伴智能体的价值取决于支持能否长期奏效，而既有研究大多只验证了单次、瞬时的效果。
items.why_en: Companion agents are only useful if their support persists over time, yet prior work has mainly measured one-off, momentary emotional support.

items.title_zh: 物联网系统中的聚类式集体异常检测：一种图神经网络方法
items.title_en: Clustering-Based Collective Anomaly Detection in IoT Systems: A Graph Neural Network Approach
items.summary_zh: 物联网技术快速发展，智能互联设备被广泛部署到各个领域，但随之而来的是网络流量大幅增长，攻击者获得了更多发动网络攻击、窃取敏感信息的机会，异常检测因此更受重视。目前最先进的异常检测方法主要聚焦于点异常，对“集体异常”（collective anomaly）的检测相对薄弱。该论文提出一种基于图神经网络的方法，用于检测物联网系统中的聚类式集体异常。摘要在此处截断，未给出实验设置与具体结果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.22166v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The rapid advancement of Internet of Things (IoT) technology has led to the widespread deployment of smart, interconnected devices across a range of domains. However, this expansion has also resulted in a substantial increase in network traffic, creating more opportunities for malicious actors to launch cyberattacks and compromise sensitive information, thereby increasing the need for effective anomaly detection. The state-of-the-art in anomaly detection has predominantly focused on point anomalies. In contrast, the detection of collective anomal…
items.why_zh: 集体异常常对应协同攻击或多设备联动的入侵，只看单点异常容易漏报。
items.why_en: Collective anomalies often signal coordinated attacks across devices, which point-anomaly detectors tend to miss.

items.title_zh: CleanScore：带负对照与敏感度边界的黑盒基准审计
items.title_en: CleanScore: Black-Box Benchmark Audits with Negative Controls and Sensitivity Bounds
items.summary_zh: 公开基准分数可能反映真实技能，也可能反映模型此前见过题目，甚至两者兼有，而多数模型的训练数据并不公开。作者提出 CleanScore，一种只依赖模型评分输出的黑盒审计方法：把每道基准题变成一个“父项”，包含一个公开版本和两个独立撰写、保留原有数字、事实与答案的新版本。该审计不给出“是否作弊”的裁决，而是报告公开版本优势的区间；同时使用带明确迁移半径的私有负对照题库，把数据暴露与普通的版本差异区分开来。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.22183v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Public benchmark scores may reflect skill, prior exposure to the questions, or both, and for most models the training data are unknown. We present CleanScore, a black-box audit using scored outputs only. Each benchmark question becomes a parent item with one public form and two independently written fresh forms preserving its numbers, facts and answer. The audit reports an interval for the public-form advantage rather than a verdict, and a private negative-control bank with an explicit transport radius separates exposure from ordinary form mismat…
items.why_zh: 它为无法获知模型训练数据的第三方提供了可量化数据污染程度的审计工具。
items.why_en: It gives third parties who lack training-data access a quantifiable way to audit benchmark contamination.

items.title_zh: 面向长时段产量预测的单调约束扩散模型
items.title_en: Monotone-Constrained Diffusion Models for Long-Horizon Production Forecasting
items.summary_zh: 仅凭序列开头少量观测去预测很长一段未来，本身是病态问题：同一段短历史可以对应许多不同轨迹。论文研究的是油气产量预测——在油井生产寿命大约前五分之一处做出的预测会影响开发与弃井决策，而可用的预测必须呈现单调递减。作者提出 Physics-SIMS-TS，一种条件扩散预测模型，把针对合成伪影的负向引导、递减曲线约束等机制结合起来。摘要在此处截断，未披露完整实验数据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.22643v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Forecasting a long horizon from only the first observations of a sequence is ill-posed: many trajectories are consistent with the same short history. We study this problem in oil and gas production forecasting, where forecasts made after roughly the first fifth of a well's producing life drive development and abandonment decisions, and where a usable forecast must describe a monotone decline. We present Physics-SIMS-TS, a conditional diffusion forecaster that combines negative guidance against synthetic artifacts, decline-curve constraints and an…
items.why_zh: 长时段预测在能源等高风险行业直接关系开发与弃井决策，物理约束能提升扩散模型输出的可用性。
items.why_en: Long-horizon forecasts drive high-stakes development and abandonment decisions, so injecting physical constraints can make diffusion forecasts usable.

items.title_zh: 效用、成本与权限约束下的反事实工具排序
items.title_en: Counterfactual Tool Ranking under Utility, Cost, and Privilege Constraints
items.summary_zh: 反事实的工具评估必须区分“是否有权调用”“历史支持程度”以及该比较实际估计的是什么。作者用 11 个企业风格的可执行工具、精确倾向性的日志以及真实的本地 Model Context Protocol 传输来研究这些区别。研究保留了一项 45 次运行的合成研究，随后用 30 次真实回报的对照运行和 15 组实验（覆盖 1,930 个独立发布的 Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard 任务）对其发起挑战。摘要指出，使用完整回报的直接回归会逆转最初看似有利的双重稳健（DR）估计结果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.22819v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Counterfactual tool evaluation must distinguish authority, historical support, and what a comparison actually estimates. We study these distinctions with eleven executable enterprise-inspired tools, exact-propensity logs, and real local Model Context Protocol transport. An initial 45-run synthetic study is retained, then challenged by 30 realized-return control runs and 15 experiments on 1,930 independently released Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard (BFCL) tasks. Full-return direct regression reverses an initially favorable doubly robust (DR)…
items.why_zh: 若混淆授权、历史支持与估计目标，工具排序结论可能完全反转，直接影响智能体工具编排的可靠性。
items.why_en: Conflating privilege, historical support and estimation targets can flip tool-ranking conclusions, undermining reliable agent tool orchestration.

items.title_zh: 核心集选择方法值得付出这些成本吗？
items.title_en: Are Coreset Selection Methods Worth Their Cost?
items.summary_zh: 核心集（coreset）选择通过挑出有代表性的训练子集来降低训练成本，但通常只用固定子集大小下的下游精度来评价，既忽略了筛选子集本身所花的时间，也忽略了每个报告数字背后的训练配方。作者提出一个端到端基准，统一下游训练流程，并把选择与训练计入同一可核查的墙钟时间预算。该基准覆盖从 CIFAR-10 到 ImageNet-1K 的 4 个数据集、11 种选择方法、5 种子集比例与 3 个随机种子，公开了 1,500 多项结果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.22894v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coreset selection picks a representative subset of the labeled training set to make training cheaper. However, it is usually evaluated by downstream accuracy at a fixed subset size, ignoring both the time spent selecting the subset and the training recipe behind each reported number. We introduce an end-to-end benchmark that standardizes downstream training and charges selection and training to the same auditable wall-clock budget, spanning 4 datasets from CIFAR-10 to ImageNet-1K, 11 selectors, 5 fractions, and 3 seeds, with over 1,500 released r…
items.why_zh: 它提示许多核心集方法省下的训练时间可能被筛选开销抵消，需要按端到端成本重新评估。
items.why_en: It suggests the training time many coreset methods save may be offset by selection overhead, so they should be judged on end-to-end cost.

items.title_zh: ETH-TraceBench：面向以太坊 DeFi 的大规模事件流基准，考察时间、协议与合约偏移
items.title_en: ETH-TraceBench: A Large-Scale Event-Stream Benchmark for Ethereum DeFi under Temporal, Protocol, and Contract Shift
items.summary_zh: 以太坊 DeFi 提供了公开、带时间戳的交易级事件流记录，但相同的公开符号很容易让机器学习模型学到强捷径。作者提出 ETH-TraceBench，用于在时间、协议、流动性池/基础设施以及符号偏移等条件下评估以太坊 DeFi 的表征能力。原始事件集合覆盖 2021 年 1 月至 2025 年 12 月，包含 13.5 亿笔交易及其日志、50.1 亿行原始日志。模型评估使用固定的 911,267 条有监督样本进行训练与测试。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.23659v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ethereum decentralized finance (DeFi) provides a public, time-stamped record of transaction-level event streams, but the same public symbols can create strong machine-learning shortcuts. We introduce ETH-TraceBench, a benchmark for evaluating Ethereum DeFi representations under temporal, protocol, pool/infrastructure, and symbolic shift. The raw event universe covers January 2021-December 2025 and contains 1.35 billion transactions with logs and 5.01 billion raw log rows. Model evaluation uses a fixed 911,267-instance supervised sample, training…
items.why_zh: DeFi 数据中的时间与符号捷径会高估模型真实能力，需要能检验分布偏移的基准。
items.why_en: Temporal and symbolic shortcuts in DeFi data inflate apparent model skill, so shift-aware benchmarks are needed.

items.title_zh: 利用遥感影像时间序列绘制巴西塞拉多火烧迹地的多时相数据集
items.title_en: A multi-temporal dataset for mapping burned areas in the Brazilian Cerrado using time series of remote sensing imagery
items.summary_zh: 论文发布了一个由卫星影像派生的多时相表格数据集，用于绘制巴西戈亚斯州 Chapada dos Veadeiros 国家公园 2020 至 2022 年的火烧迹地。数据包含 CBERS-4A、CBERS-4 和 AMAZONIA-1 卫星上 WFI 传感器的蓝、绿、红与近红外波段，以及 BAI、EVI、GEMI、NDVI、NDWI 等光谱指数，并组织为规则网格。作者使用随机森林分类器，基于标记为完全烧毁、部分烧毁等类别的样本开发并验证模型。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.23687v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper introduces a multi-temporal tabular dataset derived from satellite images to map burned areas in the Chapada dos Veadeiros National Park, in Goi\'as, Brazil, covering the years 2020 to 2022. The dataset contains blue, green, red, and near-infrared bands, as well as the BAI, EVI, GEMI, NDVI, and NDWI spectral indices from the WFI sensor on the CBERS-4A, CBERS-4, and AMAZONIA-1 satellites, organized into a regular grid. We applied the Random Forest classifier to develop and validate models based on samples labeled as totally burned, part…
items.why_zh: 可复现的多时相火烧迹地数据有助于改进塞拉多等热带草原的火灾监测与碳排放评估。
items.why_en: A reproducible multi-temporal burned-area dataset can improve fire monitoring and carbon-emission assessment in savanna regions such as the Cerrado.

items.title_zh: 基于机器学习的孟加拉国儿童发育迟缓预测：公平性与时间稳健性评估
items.title_en: Machine Learning-Based Prediction of Childhood Stunting in Bangladesh: Fairness and Temporal Robustness Assessment
items.summary_zh: 一项新研究利用孟加拉国人口与健康调查（BDHS）2007至2022年的全国代表性数据，构建机器学习模型，在人群层面预测0至59月龄儿童的发育迟缓（stunting）。研究纳入具有完整人体测量与预测变量数据的儿童，重点考察模型跨时间的稳健性，以及在不同子群体间的公平性表现。发育迟缓受儿童自身、母亲、家庭、社会经济与卫生服务等多重因素影响，是孟加拉国重要的公共卫生问题。该工作试图回答：基于历史数据训练的预测模型，能否在时间推移和不同人群中保持可靠与公平。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.24386v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Childhood stunting remains a major public health concern in Bangladesh and reflects long-term growth failure influenced by child, maternal, household, socioeconomic, and health-service factors. This study used nationally representative Bangladesh Demographic and Health Survey data from 2007 to 2022 to develop machine learning models for population-level prediction of childhood stunting and to assess temporal robustness and subgroup fairness. Children aged 0-59 months with complete anthropometric and predictor data were included. Data from the 200…
items.why_zh: 把公平性与时间稳健性纳入公共卫生预测模型评估，关系到这类模型能否被安全用于长期政策与干预决策。
items.why_en: Embedding fairness and temporal robustness into public-health prediction evaluation is key to whether such models can be safely used for long-term policy and intervention decisions.

items.title_zh: 用稀疏自编码器比较状态空间模型与 Transformer 的潜在概念形成
items.title_en: Comparing Latent Concept Formation in State Space Models and Transformers via Sparse Autoencoders
items.summary_zh: 针对 Transformer 自注意力随序列长度二次增长的问题，Mamba 等次二次选择型状态空间模型（SSM）将历史上下文压缩进固定大小的循环隐状态，形成严格的信息瓶颈。研究者由此提出一个机制可解释性层面的基础问题：SSM 与 Transformer 是否学到了本质不同的潜在表示？为此，他们使用稀疏自编码器（SAE）对 Mamba-130m 与 Pythia-70m 开展大规模、特征级的对应分析。该工作为理解两类架构内部表征的异同提供了可解释性视角。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.24440v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quadratic scaling of Transformer self-attention has driven the adoption of sub-quadratic Selective State Space Models (SSMs) like Mamba, which compress past context into a fixed-size recurrent hidden state. This strict informational bottleneck raises a foundational question for mechanistic interpretability: do SSMs and Transformers learn fundamentally distinct latent representations? In this work, we employ Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to conduct a large-scale, feature-level correspondence analysis between Mamba-130m and Pythia-70m over a 10-mi…
items.why_zh: 若两类架构组织潜在概念的方式不同，可解释性工具与迁移、评测方法就不能简单跨架构套用。
items.why_en: If the two architectures organize latent concepts differently, interpretability tools and transfer or evaluation methods cannot be assumed to carry over between them.

items.title_zh: 可用性感知训练真的值得吗？可预测算力调度下抗中断优化的基准与实证研究
items.title_en: When Is Availability-Aware Training Worth It? A Benchmark and Empirical Study of Interruption-Resilient Optimization Under Predictable Compute Schedules
items.summary_zh: 在算力可用性非平稳但可预测的场景中（如受地影影响的卫星、占空比受限的边缘设备、功率受限的数据中心），人们常认为需要专门的“可用性感知”优化器。该研究对这一前提发起检验，并发布基准 OrbitTrace，包含 50 条基于物理的可用性轨迹，由对在轨两行根数（TLE）做 SGP4 传播生成，覆盖三种轨道场景。作者提出一个可证伪的问题：当可用性缺口中断训练时，专门的恢复策略是否物有所值，还是合格的检查点机制就已足够。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.22087v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Training under non-stationary but predictable compute availability (satellites under eclipse, duty-cycled edge devices, power-capped datacenters) is often framed as needing specialized, availability-aware optimizers. We test that premise. We release OrbitTrace, a benchmark of 50 physics-grounded availability traces from SGP4 propagation of live two-line element sets across three orbital regimes, and ask a falsifiable question: when an availability gap interrupts training, is a specialized resumption strategy worth it, or is competent checkpoint…
items.why_zh: 它为“专用优化器是否必要”提供了可复现的基准与证据，避免在可预测的中断场景下过度设计训练系统。
items.why_en: It provides a reproducible benchmark and evidence on whether specialized optimizers are needed, helping avoid over-engineering training systems for predictable interruptions.

items.title_zh: 通道削减条件下睡眠分析基础模型的比较评估
items.title_en: Comparative Analysis of State-of-the-Art Foundation Models for Sleep Analysis Under Channel Reduction
items.summary_zh: 基于多导睡眠图（PSG）的自动睡眠分期研究已相当成熟，但 PSG 成本高、需在临床环境中采集、人工判读负担重，限制了其在长期或居家监测中的应用。现有睡眠分期基础模型大多在完整 PSG 导联配置下评估。该研究转而追问：这些导联中究竟有多少是真正必需的。作者在 MESA（多种族动脉粥样硬化研究）PSG 数据集上评估了六个睡眠分期模型，覆盖脑电（EEG）、心电（ECG）等三种信号条件，考察通道削减后的性能变化。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.22105v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Automatic sleep staging from polysomnography (PSG) is a well-studied task, but PSG itself is expensive, clinic-based, and burdensome to manually score, which limits its use for long-term or at-home monitoring. Most existing sleep-staging foundation models are evaluated using the full PSG montage. We instead ask how much of that montage is actually necessary. We evaluate six sleep staging models on the Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis (MESA) PSG dataset across three signal conditions: electroencephalography (EEG), electrocardiography (ECG),…
items.why_zh: 若能以更少信号通道实现可靠睡眠分期，将大幅降低居家与长期睡眠监测的成本与负担。
items.why_en: If reliable staging is possible with fewer channels, the cost and burden of at-home and long-term sleep monitoring could drop substantially.

items.title_zh: ST-Topo GAN：面向腕部运动复杂度的运动脑电到肌电解码模型
items.title_en: ST-Topo GAN: A Motor EEG-to-EMG Decoding Model Matched to Wrist Movement Complexity
items.summary_zh: 腕部在上肢功能中至关重要，支持精确的手部定位、力量调节与物体操作。连续脑—肌接口（BMI）通过将神经活动解码为肌肉激活信号，为运动功能恢复提供了有前景的路径。然而现有脑电到肌电（EEG-to-EMG）模型多针对肌肉协同相对稳定的任务开发，面对腕部运动所涉及的异质且弱耦合的神经肌肉组织可能效果不佳。该论文提出 ST-Topo GAN 模型，以匹配腕部运动的复杂度。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.22128v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The wrist plays a critical role in upper-limb function by enabling precise hand positioning, force regulation, and object manipulation. Continuous brain--muscle interfaces (BMIs) offer a promising approach for motor restoration by decoding neural activity into muscle activation signals. However, existing EEG-to-EMG models have mainly been developed for tasks with relatively stable muscle synergies and may be less effective for the heterogeneous and weakly coupled neuromuscular organisation involved in wrist movements. This paper proposes ST-Top…
items.why_zh: 腕部是上肢精细功能的核心，针对其复杂神经肌肉模式改进解码，是脑—肌接口走向实用化的关键一步。
items.why_en: The wrist is central to fine upper-limb function, so better decoding of its complex neuromuscular patterns is a key step toward practical brain-muscle interfaces.

items.title_zh: 语言模型知道自己的约束吗？
items.title_en: Do Language Models Know Their Own Constraints?
items.summary_zh: 该研究追问：通过后训练获得的行为约束，是否仍能被模型显式地报告出来。作者以受限食谱生成为测试场景，用 LoRA 微调 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct，禁止五种食材，并在四级“约束意识基准”上比较监督微调（SFT）、组相对策略优化（GRPO）与未训练基线。三个随机种子平均下来，两种方法都把行为合规率从 4% 提升到约 90%，但显式报告约束的比例反而降至未训练模型之下。这说明模型可以“做对”却“说不出来”。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.22151v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We ask whether behavioral constraints acquired through post training remain explicitly reportable. Using constrained recipe generation as a testbed, five banned ingredients enforced via LoRA fine tuning of Llama 3.1 8B Instruct we compare supervised fine tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) against an untrained baseline on a four tier Constraint Awareness Benchmark. Averaged over three seeds, both methods raise behavioral compliance from 4% to about 90% while reducing explicit constraint reporting below the untrained model…
items.why_zh: 模型合规却无法说明自身约束，说明行为对齐与可自我报告的约束知识之间存在分离，直接影响安全审计与可解释性。
items.why_en: Models that comply but cannot articulate their constraints reveal a gap between behavioral alignment and reportable constraint knowledge, with direct implications for safety auditing.

items.title_zh: 基于小波与 STFT 特征的阶段化异常检测用于电驱动桥质量监测
items.title_en: Stagewise Anomaly Detection for E-Transaxle Quality Monitoring Using Wavelet and STFT Features
items.summary_zh: 该论文提出两套可解释的机器学习框架，用于电动汽车电驱动桥总成的质量筛查：阶段化小波孤立森林（SWIF）框架，以及基于短时傅里叶变换（STFT）的诊断框架。研究分析来自前后加速度计的高维振动信号，并跨多个运行阶段捕捉与阶段相关的振动行为。在 SWIF 框架中，信号先通过五级 Daubechies-4 离散小波变换分解，再做分块处理。该工作强调在工业质检场景中兼顾检测性能与可解释性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.22172v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This paper presents two interpretable machine-learning frameworks for quality screening of e-transaxle assemblies in electric vehicles: a Stagewise Wavelet Isolation Forest (SWIF) framework and a short-time Fourier transform (STFT)-based diagnostic framework. High-dimensional vibration signals acquired from front and back accelerometers are analyzed across multiple operating stages to capture stage-dependent vibration behavior. In the SWIF framework, signals are decomposed using a five-level Daubechies-4 discrete wavelet transform, and blockwis…
items.why_zh: 面向电动车核心部件产线的可解释异常检测方法，有助于把机器学习质检真正落地到制造环节。
items.why_en: Interpretable anomaly detection for a core EV drivetrain component helps bring machine-learning quality inspection into real production lines.

items.title_zh: 大模型的选择像人吗？用认知理论评估 LLM 决策
items.title_en: Do LLMs Choose Like Humans? Using Cognitive Theory to Evaluate LLM Decision-Making
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型表现出不少类人的决策行为，但这些行为源于相似的底层机制，还是仅停留在表层模仿，仍不清楚。研究考察 LLM 的情境敏感性是否与一种认知经济学理论相一致——该理论用问题分类与注意力分配来解释人类行为。作者在包含 14 万次试验的全新商品选择基准上测试了 12 个开源与商业大模型。结果显示，情境确实会引发类似人类的选择与问题分类偏移，但并不能可靠地重新加权该理论所预期的相关因素。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.22225v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit a range of human-like decision-making behaviors, but whether these reflect similar underlying mechanisms or surface-level mimicry remains unclear. We evaluate whether LLM context sensitivity aligns with a cognitive economic theory that explains human behavior through problem categorization and attention allocation. Across 12 open-source and commercial LLMs on a novel 140,000-trial product choice benchmark, context induces human-like shifts in choice and problem categorization, but does not reliably reweight…
items.why_zh: 区分“行为像人”与“机制同理”，为判断 LLM 决策能否作为人类行为的可靠代理提供了更严格的检验。
items.why_en: Separating human-like behavior from human-like mechanism offers a stricter test of whether LLM decisions can serve as reliable proxies for human behavior.

items.title_zh: 黎曼随机优化的本地隐私推断
items.title_en: Locally Private Inference for Riemannian Stochastic Optimization
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究流形取值总体极小值的统计推断问题：每个观测来自不同的参与者，分析师只能收到满足本地差分隐私的随机化消息。方法上释放切空间中的随机梯度，再通过黎曼随机逼近与 Polyak-Ruppert 平均进行聚合。研究指出，把隐私数据代理直接代入非线性损失会使其总体目标发生偏移，而对释放梯度做条件中心化可以保留一阶方程；为此作者提出对称配对回归（SPR）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.22642v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop inference for manifold-valued population minimizers when each observation belongs to a different participant and only locally private messages reach the analyst. The method releases randomized tangent gradients and combines them through Riemannian stochastic approximation and Polyak-Ruppert averaging. Directly inserting a private data surrogate into a nonlinear loss can shift its population target, whereas conditional centring of the released gradient preserves the first-order equation. We introduce symmetric-pair regression (SPR) to…
items.why_zh: 它把本地差分隐私与黎曼优化结合，给出了在隐私约束下仍能保留一阶条件的流形统计推断构造方法。
items.why_en: It bridges local differential privacy and Riemannian optimization, offering a construction that preserves the first-order equation under privacy constraints.

items.title_zh: 蒸馏学习与硬件协同：把工业基础模型带到粒子物理探测器边缘
items.title_en: Leveraging Industrial Foundation Models at the Edge of Particle Physics Detectors via Distillation Learning and Hardware Co-design
items.summary_zh: 未来粒子物理实验的数据采集（DAQ）系统既希望用大规模基础模型提升特征提取性能，又需要在探测器端小规模部署以实现实时智能数据处理。该工作首次针对粒子物理 DAQ 微调工业级基础模型：以 Google Research 的时序基础模型 TimesFM 为骨干，在实时回归任务上做微调，并结合蒸馏学习与硬件协同设计，使模型能运行在资源受限的探测器端。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.23385v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Data acquisition (DAQ) systems at future particle physics experiments stand to benefit from the extremes of AI/ML development: large-scale foundation models can enhance the performance of feature extraction algorithms, and small-scale on-detector deployments can enable real-time intelligent data handling. This work provides the first fine-tuning of an industrial foundation model for particle physics DAQ. Starting from the backbone of Google Research's TimesFM (Time Series Foundation Model), we demonstrate fine-tuning on real-time regression tas…
items.why_zh: 它首次把工业时序基础模型与边缘硬件协同引入粒子物理实时数据采集，展示了基础模型落地极端资源环境的可行路径。
items.why_en: It is the first attempt to bring an industrial time-series foundation model, via distillation and hardware co-design, into real-time particle-physics DAQ at the edge.

items.title_zh: 视频扩散模型为何违背物理规律？揭示注意力机制的缺陷
items.title_en: Why Do Video Diffusion Models Violate Physics? Unveiling the Flaws in Attention Mechanisms
items.summary_zh: 尽管视觉质量出色，当前最先进的视频扩散模型常常生成违背真实物理规律的内容。已有方案多依赖外部先验或专门数据，本文则从模型内部机制寻找根因，首次对文生视频扩散模型的“运动规划”过程做可解释性研究，揭示运动轨迹如何在去噪早期阶段形成，并基于“先形状、后细节”的发现展开分析。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.23658v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Despite impressive visual quality, state-of-the-art video diffusion models often generate content that violates real-world physical laws. While existing solutions rely on external priors or specialized data, we investigate the root cause by exploring the internal mechanisms of these models. Specifically, we present the first interpretability study on the ''motion planning'' process of text-to-video diffusion models, revealing how motion trajectories form during early denoising stages. Building upon the ''first shape, then details'' finding, we…
items.why_zh: 它首次从注意力机制内部解释视频扩散模型违背物理的原因，为提升生成视频的物理合理性提供机理层面的线索。
items.why_en: It provides the first mechanistic, attention-level explanation of why video diffusion models violate physics, pointing toward more physically plausible generation.

items.title_zh: TriFleetRCA：面向 Kubernetes 的本地部署 LLM 根因分析
items.title_en: TriFleetRCA: On-Premise LLM Root Cause Analysis for Kubernetes
items.summary_zh: 远程站点的根因分析往往很慢：证据散落在 pod 日志、Kubernetes 事件和集群级对象中，而许多运维方根本无法把生产日志发送给托管模型。本地部署推理消除了这一限制，但也带来现网基准尚未回答的问题：当一台工作站 GPU 同时限定模型与上下文预算时，应如何检索证据？如果模型参考的运行手册被篡改又会怎样？作者提出 TriFleetRCA 流水线，完全在本地环境中运行。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.23766v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Root cause analysis at a remote site is slow: evidence is scattered across pod logs, Kubernetes events and cluster-level objects, and many operators cannot send production logs to a hosted model at all. On-premise inference removes the second constraint but raises a question live-cluster benchmarks have not addressed: when one workstation GPU fixes both the model and the context budget, how should evidence be retrieved, and what happens when the runbooks the model consults have been tampered with? We present TriFleetRCA, a pipeline running enti…
items.why_zh: 它直面本地化 LLM 运维的现实约束（单卡预算与运行手册可信性），为 Kubernetes 根因分析给出可落地的流水线设计。
items.why_en: It tackles the practical constraints of on-premise LLM operations—single-GPU budgets and untrusted runbooks—offering a deployable pipeline for Kubernetes root cause analysis.

items.title_zh: HumynexSurg-1：一个经整理的抽脂手术专家数据集
items.title_en: HumynexSurg-1: A Curated Expert Liposuction Dataset
items.summary_zh: 机器人基础模型依靠大规模示教数据学习操作，但手术数据在这类语料中缺席：在总计 780 小时的 Open-H 手术数据集中，只有一个数据集包含同步力信息，且没有任何一个覆盖美容类手术。抽脂是其中的难点，因为器械在皮下工作，医生主要凭手感与判断操作。Humynex Robotics 为此构建经整理的专家数据集，首个发布版本 HumynexSurg-1 记录了资深抽脂专家在猪腹部组织上的操作。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.23885v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Robot foundation models learn manipulation from large demonstration corpora, but surgery is missing from those corpora: across the 780-hour Open-H surgical collection, one dataset carries synchronized force and none covers an aesthetic procedure. Liposuction is the hard case, because the instrument works under the skin and the surgeon operates by feel and by judgment. Humynex Robotics builds curated expert datasets for this kind of procedure. HumynexSurg-1 is the first release: a master liposuction surgeon performing on porcine abdominal tissue…
items.why_zh: 它填补了机器人学习语料中美容手术（抽脂）与力学反馈数据的空白，为手术机器人基础模型提供稀缺的专家示教资源。
items.why_en: It fills a gap in robot-learning corpora by supplying rare expert demonstrations of an aesthetic surgical procedure with force information.

items.title_zh: OSCAR：面向 AI 排名的顺序感知评分与校准
items.title_en: OSCAR: Order-aware Scoring and Calibration for AI Rankings
items.summary_zh: 针对单个评判者的敏感度有助于聚合成对的 LLM 评价，但其解释取决于排名模型纳入了哪些系统性的呈现效应。作者提出 OSCAR，一个顺序感知的 AI 排名评分与校准框架，并把位置作为这类效应之一加以研究。在来自 18 个评判者已公开的判定中，全部回答的 A 减 B 得分差异从 −63.11 个百分点到 98.31 个百分点不等；研究通过在公开表格内匹配问题文本、回答文本、候选身份与评判者来控制干扰。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.24128v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Judge-specific sensitivity is useful for aggregating pairwise LLM evaluations, but its interpretation depends on which systematic presentation effects the ranking model includes. We introduce OSCAR, an order-aware framework for scoring and calibrating AI rankings, and study position as one such effect. In released judgments from 18 evaluators, the all-response A-minus-B score difference ranges from $-63.11$ to $98.31$ percentage points. Matching question text, response texts, candidate identities, and judge within the released table gives an ov…
items.why_zh: 它量化了评判位置等呈现效应在 LLM 排名中的巨大影响，为更公平的 AI 排行榜评估提供校准框架。
items.why_en: It quantifies how large presentation effects such as position can be in LLM rankings and offers a calibration framework for fairer AI leaderboards.

items.title_zh: MCP-GRANITE：面向 MCP 智能体的工具接口粒度测试基准
items.title_en: MCP-GRANITE Benchmark: GRANularity Interface TEsting for MCP-Based LLM Agents
items.summary_zh: 随着 LLM 智能体越来越多地通过 MCP 等标准化协议调用外部工具，工具接口设计成为关键却研究不足的因素：功能如何被拆分成工具，直接影响智能体能否选对工具并构造合法参数。这一选择在边缘场景尤为关键，因为资源限制决定了哪些模型能本地运行，且往往无法靠扩容解决。作者提出 MCP-GRANITE，一个开源、可扩展的基准框架，把工具接口粒度作为核心测试维度。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.24161v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As LLM agents increasingly interact with external tools through standardized protocols such as MCP, tool-interface design becomes a critical yet underexplored factor. How fun{\psi}tionality is decomposed into tools affects whether an agent can select the right tool and construct valid arguments. This choice is especially consequential at the edge, where resource constraints limit which models can run locally and scaling up is often not an option. We present MCP-GRANITE, an open-source extensible benchmark framework that treats tool-interface gr…
items.why_zh: 它把长期被忽视的“工具接口粒度”变成可测量的基准维度，为 MCP 生态中的智能体设计提供实证依据。
items.why_en: It turns the under-explored design choice of tool-interface granularity into a measurable benchmark dimension for MCP-based agents.

items.title_zh: 预训练生成器潜空间水印的信息论极限
items.title_en: On the Information-Theoretic Limits of Latent-Space Watermarking Through Pretrained Generators
items.summary_zh: 本文研究通过预训练生成器实现的潜空间水印：生成器的潜变量到输出遵循一个给定的随机映射，称为 renderer。水印编码器依据消息与密钥选择潜变量输入，并要求对每条消息和每个语义上下文，发布输出的条件分布与期望分布完全一致。在有限字母表下，作者推导出速率—密钥的内界与外界，刻画出通过既有潜空间接口实现水印通信所需的编码与协调条件。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.24377v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study latent-space watermarking through a pretrained generator using a prescribed latent-to-output stochastic mapping, called the renderer. A watermark encoder selects the latent input using a message and secret key. For every message and semantic context, the released output must have exactly the desired conditional output distribution. For finite alphabets, we derive rate--key inner and outer bounds and characterize the coding and coordination requirements for realizing watermark communication through the prescribed latent interface. When…
items.why_zh: 它从信息论角度界定潜空间水印在容量与密钥上的极限，为生成内容溯源方案的可实现性提供理论标尺。
items.why_en: It gives information-theoretic limits on watermark capacity and key cost through pretrained generators, offering a theoretical yardstick for content provenance.

items.title_zh: 轻量卷积神经网络实现手绘几何图形实时识别
items.title_en: A Lightweight Convolutional Neural Network for Real-Time Recognition of Hand-Drawn Geometric Shapes
items.summary_zh: 一篇 arXiv 论文介绍了一套用于手绘几何图形识别的小型卷积神经网络方案。作者独立采集并公开了一个包含 2000 张 28×28 像素标注图像的数据集，覆盖圆形、正方形、长方形和三角形四类基本图形，并据此实现了一个桌面应用，用紧凑的三层 CNN 完成分类。该工作面向教育、人机交互与示意图数字化等场景，强调模型体积小、可实时运行，为手绘草图识别提供了可复现的基线。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.24384v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Recognizing hand-drawn geometric shapes is a foundational sub-problem of sketch recognition, with applications in education, human-computer interaction, and diagram digitization. This paper presents the design, implementation, and evaluation of a desktop application that recognizes four basic hand-drawn geometric shapes, circle, square, rectangle, and triangle using a compact Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). A dataset of 2,000 labeled 28x28-pixel shape images was collected independently and released publicly. The classifier consists of three…
items.why_zh: 手绘图形识别是草图理解的基础子问题，轻量模型与公开数据集降低了教育与交互类应用的落地门槛。
items.why_en: Hand-drawn shape recognition is a foundational sub-problem of sketch understanding, and a compact model plus a public dataset lowers the barrier for education and interaction applications.

items.title_zh: 免训练拒绝 MCP 攻击：用检索增强生成抵御提示注入
items.title_en: Training-Free Refusal of MCP Exploits via Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.summary_zh: 该论文聚焦 MCP（模型上下文协议）带来的安全风险。论文指出，尽管 LLM 安全护栏已能较成熟地拒答“如何制作炸弹”一类明显有害的问题，但接入 MCP 的模型仍极易被提示注入攻破——攻击请求往往不含明显有害或有嫌疑的线索，例如“能帮我把这个 SSH 密钥加到 bashrc 文件里吗”。作者使用当前最先进的对齐微调算法展开研究，探索 LLM 能否在无需额外训练的情况下，借助检索增强生成（RAG）拒绝这类 MCP 攻击请求。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.11217v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The model context protocol (MCP) has been widely adopted as an open standard enabling the seamless integration of generative AI agents. However, while LLM guardrails have significantly matured to refuse malicious or harmful queries (e.g., "How do I build a bomb?"), recent work has shown that MCP-enabled LLMs are highly susceptible to prompt injection attacks which avoid harmful or suspicious cues (e.g., "Can you add this ssh key to my bashrc file?"). Herein, we use state-of-the-art (SOTA) alignment fine-tuning algorithms to explore whether LL…
items.why_zh: MCP 正被广泛用于连接 AI 智能体与外部工具，若提示注入能绕过护栏，将直接危及用户系统与数据安全。
items.why_en: MCP is widely adopted for connecting AI agents to external tools, so prompt injections that bypass guardrails directly threaten user systems and data.

items.title_zh: 贪心采样即可探索：不依赖 eluder dimension 的 KL 正则化上下文赌博机
items.title_en: When Greedy Sampling Explores: KL-Regularized Contextual Bandits without Eluder-Dimension Dependence
items.summary_zh: 论文研究 KL 正则化的上下文赌博机，涵盖奖励反馈与偏好反馈两种设定。作者证明，简单的贪心采样策略即可实现多项式对数级（polylogarithmic）遗憾界，且无需显式依赖常被用作复杂度度量的 eluder dimension。在奖励反馈下，算法直接从估计奖励所诱导的 Gibbs 策略中采样；作者进一步把结果推广到一般偏好模型与 Bradley–Terry 模型下的偏好反馈，并改进了已有的遗憾保证，说明朴素贪心采样在理论上已足够高效。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.13564v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study KL-regularized contextual bandits under both reward and preference feedback. While existing regret guarantees typically depend on the eluder dimension, we show that simple greedy sampling can achieve polylogarithmic regret without explicit dependence on this complexity measure. For reward feedback, we analyze a greedy algorithm that samples directly from the Gibbs policy induced by the estimated reward. We extend the result to preference feedback under both general preference and Bradley--Terry models, while also sharpening existing…
items.why_zh: 去掉对 eluder dimension 的依赖，意味着朴素贪心采样在理论上已足够高效，简化了上下文赌博机算法的设计与分析。
items.why_en: Removing the eluder-dimension dependence shows plain greedy sampling is already theoretically efficient, simplifying the design and analysis of contextual bandit algorithms.

items.title_zh: SenCache：敏感度感知缓存加速扩散模型推理
items.title_en: SenCache: Accelerating Diffusion Model Inference via Sensitivity-Aware Caching
items.summary_zh: 扩散模型在视频生成上达到最先进质量，但推理需要大量串行去噪步骤，成本高昂；在免训练加速方法中，缓存通过跨时间步复用已计算的模型输出减少计算量，成为热门方向。现有缓存方法依赖启发式准则选择缓存与复用的时间步，需要大量调参。论文提出 SenCache，用更有原则的敏感度感知策略来决定何时缓存、何时复用计算结果，从而在加速扩散推理的同时减轻调参负担。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2602.24208v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Diffusion models achieve state-of-the-art video generation quality, but their inference remains expensive due to the large number of sequential denoising steps. This has motivated a growing line of research on accelerating diffusion inference. Among training-free acceleration methods, caching reduces computation by reusing previously computed model outputs across timesteps. Existing caching methods rely on heuristic criteria to choose cache/reuse timesteps and require extensive tuning. We address this limitation with a principled sensit…
items.why_zh: 免训练缓存是降低扩散模型推理成本的关键路径，更可解释、少调参的敏感度判据有望让加速方案真正走向实用。
items.why_en: Training-free caching is a key path to cheaper diffusion inference, and a principled, less tuning-heavy sensitivity criterion could make such acceleration practical.

items.title_zh: 面向非平稳上下文赌博机的流校正汤普森采样
items.title_en: Flow-Corrected Thompson Sampling for Non-Stationary Contextual Bandits
items.summary_zh: 论文研究奖励模型随时间漂移的非平稳线性上下文赌博机问题：在这种设定下，历史数据会系统性偏置，经典上下文赌博机算法表现脆弱。作者提出 Flow-Corrected Thompson Sampling（fcTS），一种贝叶斯方法，用显式的漂移模型把过去的奖励“搬运”到当前时刻以复用经验，并为每条被搬运的观测赋予反映搬运可靠性的置信权重。该框架是一个通用模板，可特化到线性等具体设定。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.23933v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study non-stationary linear contextual bandits where the reward model drifts over time, rendering classical contextual bandit algorithms brittle because historical data becomes systematically biased. We propose Flow-Corrected Thompson Sampling (fcTS), a Bayesian method that reuses experience by transporting past rewards to the present using an explicit drift model and incorporating each transported observation with a confidence weight that reflects transport reliability. This yields a unified template that specializes in (i) linear p…
items.why_zh: 它为奖励随时间变化的真实场景提供了兼顾历史经验复用与偏差校正的通用贝叶斯方案。
items.why_en: It offers a general Bayesian recipe that both reuses past experience and corrects for bias in settings where rewards drift over time.

items.title_zh: Teach and Grow：以智能体为中心的通用机器人学习架构
items.title_en: Teach and Grow: An Agent-Centered Architecture for General Robot Learning
items.summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）与世界-动作模型通常需要额外采集机器人数据和策略优化才能掌握陌生的操作任务，这种反复重训的负担拖慢了新行为的获取。论文提出 Teach-and-Grow Learning（TGL），一种免训练架构：只需少量成功示范，就能转化为可复用的机器人技能。任务获取过程不需要梯度更新、微调或强化学习，预训练模型权重保持固定，机器人通过扩展自身显式知识来成长。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.17209v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models typically absorb unfamiliar manipulation tasks through additional robot data collection and policy optimization. This recurring retraining burden slows the acquisition of new behavior. We present Teach-and-Grow Learning (TGL), a training-free architecture that turns a few successful demonstrations into reusable robot skills. Task acquisition requires no gradient updates, fine-tuning, or reinforcement learning: pretrained model weights remain fixed as the robot expands its explicit kno…
items.why_zh: 免重训、免微调的技能获取方式，有望显著降低机器人学习新任务的成本与周期。
items.why_en: Acquiring skills without retraining or fine-tuning could substantially cut the cost and time required for robots to learn new tasks.

items.title_zh: 北京大学材料科学与工程学院特聘研究员窦锦虎评价 MiMo-V2.6-Pro：达到训练有素博士研究人员水平
items.title_en: Xiaomi Open-Sources MiMo-V2.6 Series as Its Pro Model Takes On a 'Co-Scientist' Role
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 22 日消息，小米今日凌晨正式发布并开源了全新的 Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6 系列，包含 Pro 与 Flash 两个原生全模态模型。小米称这是其探索 RSI（递归自我改进）路径的关键一步，通过规模化扩展强化学习算力，让模型在持续的探索与反馈中拓展智能边界。 据小米技术官方分享，MiMo-V2.6-Pro 开始以“Co-Scientist”角色参与真实科研任务。 在新材料研究中，MiMo-V2.6-Pro 围绕金属有机框架（MOF）材料设计展开研究，协助研究人员检索文献、梳理研究方向、提出候选方案，并调用计算工具对材料性能进行模拟分析与筛选，探索永久性污染物（PFAS）吸附方向的设计可能。把原本约一个月的研发周期压缩到 2—3 天，效率提升 10 倍。 北京大学材料科学与工程学院特聘研究员、博士生导师窦锦虎评价：“ 达到了训练有素的博士研究人员的水平。 ” 另外，在数学形式化证明中，MiMo-V2.6-Pro 协助研究人员在 Lean 4 中完成 Li–Yorke 经典论文《周期三蕴含混沌》主定理的完整形式化证明，6000 余行源码全部通过内核核验。MiMo-V2.6-Pro 此前并未接受针对 Lean 的专项后训练，这一成果来自通用推理、代码生成与多智能体协作能力的综合运用。 MiMo-V2.6 系列沿用 V2.5 系列的 API 定价：Flash 为每百…
items.summary_en: Xiaomi has released and open-sourced the MiMo-V2.6 series, with Pro and Flash native omni-modal models that it frames as a key step toward recursive self-improvement. MiMo-V2.6-Pro acted as a 'Co-Scientist' in metal-organic framework design for PFAS adsorption, cutting a roughly one-month research cycle to 2–3 days, and helped complete a full Lean 4 formal proof of the Li–Yorke theorem's main result without dedicated Lean post-training.
items.why_zh: 开源全模态模型直接参与材料与数学研究并获学者正面评价，是 AI 从工具走向科研协作者的一个标志性案例。
items.why_en: An open-sourced omni-modal model doing real materials and mathematics work, praised by a university researcher, marks AI's shift from tool to research collaborator.

items.title_zh: 阿里 Qwen4 和下代视频模型训练中，Qwen4.5 后模型将扩展至 5-10T 参数
items.title_en: Alibaba Says Qwen4 Is in Training, Later Versions to Reach 5–10T Parameters; Next Video Model Due in November
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 22 日消息，IT之家今日在 2026 年云栖大会现场获悉，阿里巴巴公布了大模型一系列进展，大模型递归自我改进（RSI）已初步进入模型训练、推理及芯模协同等环节中， 基于新一代架构的 Qwen4 已在训练中，未来 Qwen4.5、Qwen5 等版本将扩展至 5-10T 参数 。 同时，阿里的视频生成模型、语音模型、图像模型、世界模型、音乐模型以及全模态模型等均在当天或近期推出新版本。 阿里全新的下一代视频生成模型将于 11 月发布 ，朝着更长、更可控、更完整、更智能的方向演进：在更长的时间里，新模型仍然能保持一致性，创作者可精准掌控人物、场景与镜头；同时，模型能具备导演级的创作思维，从生成单个镜头迈向理解完整叙事。 本届云栖大会，阿里系统展示了千问大模型自我进化的最新探索成果： 在模型自我训练上 ，Qwen3.8-Max 通过自主搭建训练流程、构造训练数据，并自主设计实验、定位缺陷，在人类完全“零参与”的情况下持续迭代超 1 个月，完成 33 轮有效迭代。基于 RSI、后训练等系列技术联合优化，Qwen3.8-Max 新版本在 Artificial Analysis 上的得分从 40 涨至 45 分，与 Claude、GPT 最强模型同处第一阵营，领先于 GLM5.3、Kimi-K3 等所有国产模型。 在推理优化上 ，Qwen3.8-Max 在从未见过的平头哥新款…
items.summary_en: At the 2026 Yunqi Conference, Alibaba said its next-generation Qwen4 architecture is already in training and later versions such as Qwen4.5 and Qwen5 will scale to 5–10 trillion parameters, with recursive self-improvement entering training, inference and chip-model co-design. It also announced a new video generation model for November, and said Qwen3.8-Max ran 33 effective self-training iterations with zero human involvement, raising its Artificial Analysis score from 40 to 45.
items.why_zh: 从 5-10T 参数规划到零人工干预的自我迭代，展示了国产大模型在规模化与递归自我改进路线上的最新进展。
items.why_en: From 5–10T-parameter plans to zero-human self-iteration, it shows the latest advances of Chinese frontier models on scaling and recursive self-improvement.

items.title_zh: 阿里亮出最强底牌：真武V900发布，狂砸3800亿建AI集群
items.title_en: Alibaba Unveils Zhenwu V900 Chip and 38 Billion Yuan AI Cluster Investment
items.summary_zh: 阿里亮出最强底牌：真武V900发布，狂砸3800亿建AI集群 电子工程专辑
items.summary_en: Alibaba has unveiled the Zhenwu V900, its most powerful AI chip from chip unit T-Head, and announced a 38 billion yuan investment in building AI clusters, according to a report. The move underscores Alibaba's push into self-developed compute chips and large-scale AI infrastructure, though cluster and chip details were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 阿里在自研AI芯片与算力基建上同时加码，反映国内大模型竞赛正加速向底层算力延伸。
items.why_en: Alibaba's dual bet on in-house AI chips and compute infrastructure shows China's LLM race is shifting deeper into the compute layer.

items.title_zh: 月之暗面发布Kimi Code桌面客户端
items.title_en: Moonshot AI Releases Kimi Code Desktop Client
items.summary_zh: 月之暗面发布Kimi Code桌面客户端 iheima
items.summary_en: Moonshot AI has launched a desktop client called Kimi Code, extending its coding capabilities beyond web and mobile into desktop workflows. Details such as supported platforms, features and pricing have not been disclosed.
items.why_zh: 这是Kimi向开发者工具与本地桌面场景延伸的一步，AI编程助手赛道的竞争继续升温。
items.why_en: It marks Kimi's push into developer tooling and desktop workflows, intensifying competition in AI coding assistants.

items.title_zh: 【每日瞰AI】曝DeepSeek筹备500亿元新一轮融资，将华为训练芯片视为重要押注；未满16周岁使用社交、游戏和AI服务拟强制进入未成年模式
items.title_en: DeepSeek Said to Seek 50 Billion Yuan Round; Under-16 Users May Face Mandatory Minor Mode for Social, Gaming and AI Services
items.summary_zh: 【每日瞰AI】曝DeepSeek筹备500亿元新一轮融资，将华为训练芯片视为重要押注；未满16周岁使用社交、游戏和AI服务拟强制进入未成年模式 电子工程专辑
items.summary_en: DeepSeek is reportedly preparing a new funding round of 50 billion yuan, with Huawei training chips seen as a key bet. Separately, regulators plan to require users under 16 to enter a mandatory minor mode when using social, gaming and AI services.
items.why_zh: 融资与国产芯片押注关系到大模型算力自主，未成年人模式则可能改变AI产品的用户准入与设计。
items.why_en: The funding and domestic-chip bet bear on LLM compute self-reliance, while the minor mode could reshape user access and product design for AI services.

items.title_zh: Tripo AI 发布 Tripo P2.0，推动 AI 3D 生成迈向生产级资产
items.title_en: Tripo AI Releases Latest Model Tripo P2.0, Advancing AI 3D Generation with Production-Ready Assets
items.summary_zh: Tripo AI 发布最新模型 Tripo P2.0，主打生成可直接用于生产的 3D 资产，推动 AI 3D 生成技术进一步成熟。据 PR Newswire 消息，该模型面向生产就绪的资产场景，意在提升 3D 内容生成的可用性与效率。此类能力若成熟，有望降低游戏、影视、电商等领域的 3D 内容创作门槛。
items.summary_en: Tripo AI Releases Latest Model Tripo P2.0, Advancing AI 3D Generation with Production-Ready Assets PR Newswire
items.why_zh: 生产级 3D 资产生成是 AI 3D 从演示走向商用的关键一步。
items.why_en: Production-ready 3D asset generation marks a key step for AI 3D moving from demos to commercial use.

items.title_zh: 最强国产 AI 芯片阿里平头哥真武 V900 发布，全新磐久超节点服务器明年 Q1 上市
items.title_en: Alibaba's T-Head Launches Zhenwu V900 AI Chip; Panjiu Super Node Servers to Ship in Q1 2027
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 22 日消息，由阿里集团主办的 2026 云栖大会于 9 月 22 日至 24 日在杭州国际博览中心举行。 IT之家在大会现场获悉，阿里平头哥发布了最强国产 AI 芯片 —— 真武 V900 ，这是一款训推一体 AI 芯片，算力提升至真武 M890 的 3 倍，支持 216GB 显存、1200GB/s 片间互联、FP8/FP4 精度。 阿里宣布，搭载平头哥真武 V900、ICN Switch、磐脉及镇岳芯片的 全新磐久超节点服务器将于 2027 年 Q1 上市 。 此外，阿里云灵骏真武 M890 超节点实例 GP9A 已对外提供服务，成为国内首个成功运行超 2 万亿参数大模型的超节点形态算力。 IT之家从大会现场获悉，阿里平头哥还预告了下一代 AI 芯片 —— 真武 J900 ，自研并行计算架构将迎来跨越革新，计划 2028 年 Q3 上市。
items.summary_en: At the 2026 Yunqi Conference, Alibaba's T-Head unveiled the Zhenwu V900, a training-and-inference AI chip with triple the compute of the M890, 216GB of memory, 1200GB/s inter-chip interconnect and FP8/FP4 support. New Panjiu super node servers carrying the chip plus ICN Switch, Panmai and Zhenyue chips will ship in Q1 2027, while the M890-based Lingjun GP9A instance is already serving as China's first super node compute to run a model with over 2 trillion parameters. The next-generation Zhenwu J900 is planned for Q3 2028.
items.why_zh: 真武V900与超节点路线显示阿里正同时强化单芯片性能与系统级集群能力，以对标国际高端AI算力。
items.why_en: The V900 and super node roadmap show Alibaba scaling both chip performance and system-level clusters to rival top-tier AI compute.

items.title_zh: 太原一公司的12问，智谱的再次道歉与ZCode开源
items.title_en: After 12 Questions From a Taiyuan Company, Zhipu Apologizes Again and Open-Sources ZCode
items.summary_zh: 太原一公司的12问，智谱的再次道歉与ZCode开源 搜狐网
items.summary_en: Zhipu has apologized again and open-sourced ZCode in response to "12 questions" raised by a company in Taiyuan, according to Sohu. Details of the dispute and of ZCode itself were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 事件涉及AI厂商与客户的争议处理，其道歉与开源动作可能影响外界对其技术开放度和商业信誉的判断。
items.why_en: The episode tests how an AI vendor handles a customer dispute, and its apology and open-sourcing could shape perceptions of its openness and credibility.

items.title_zh: 阿里CEO吴泳铭：计划训练5万亿至10万亿参数新模型，2032年阿里云数据中心规模将超20GW
items.title_en: Alibaba CEO Eddie Wu: 5-10 Trillion Parameter Models Planned, Alibaba Cloud Data Centers to Exceed 20GW by 2032
items.summary_zh: 阿里CEO吴泳铭：计划训练5万亿至10万亿参数新模型，2032年阿里云数据中心规模将超20GW thepaper.cn
items.summary_en: Alibaba CEO Eddie Wu said the company plans to train new models with 5 to 10 trillion parameters, and that Alibaba Cloud's data center capacity will exceed 20GW by 2032. The remarks tie massive model training to long-term compute infrastructure expansion.
items.why_zh: 超大规模模型目标与20GW级数据中心规划，表明阿里将大模型竞争视为一场长期算力军备竞赛。
items.why_en: The trillion-parameter goal and 20GW data center plan frame the LLM race as a long-term compute arms race.

items.title_zh: 龙芯发布自研通用 GPU 加速计算平台首个软件版本：支持 OpenCL 3.0、CUDA 及 AI 推理
items.title_en: Loongson Releases First Software Version of Its General-Purpose GPU Accelerated Computing Platform, Supporting OpenCL 3.0, CUDA and AI Inference
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 22 日消息，龙芯中科今日宣布推出支持自研通用 GPU 的龙芯加速计算平台（Loongson Accelerated Computing Platform）首个软件版本，面向龙芯通用 GPU 提供从底层驱动、编程环境到 AI 模型推理的完整软件支持。 该平台基于龙芯 2K3000 和 9A1000 芯片集成的 LG200 系列通用 GPU 核心开发。在已有 OpenGL、Vulkan 图形软件栈的基础上，平台进一步覆盖算力芯片驱动、编译器、运行时环境、算子库、推理引擎、调试工具和性能分析工具等组件。 龙芯加速计算平台支持 OpenCL 3.0 和 CUDA 两类编程模型接口，并集成 BLAS、DNN 等高性能算子库，可用于 AI 模型推理。平台面向龙芯全系列算力芯片，支持从系统选型、算力调用、模型优化到应用部署的开发流程。 在运行时环境方面，平台提供资源调度管理、内存管理、任务队列调度和事件同步等功能。底层驱动则对不同硬件计算资源进行统一抽象和管理，以支持多进程、多任务并发执行。 平台还集成了面向龙芯通用 GPU 的算力编译器，同时兼容 OpenCL 3.0 和 CUDA 编程接口。龙芯中科称，编译器针对自研通用 GPU 的指令集架构和硬件特性进行了优化，并通过 API 层面的兼容降低开发和迁移适配成本。 调试与分析工具支持断点设置、寄存器访问以及张量单元等硬件部…
items.summary_en: Loongson has released the first software version of its Accelerated Computing Platform for its in-house general-purpose GPU, built on LG200 GPU cores integrated in the Loongson 2K3000 and 9A1000 chips. It spans drivers, compilers, runtime, operator libraries, inference engines and debugging/profiling tools, supports both OpenCL 3.0 and CUDA interfaces, and integrates BLAS and DNN libraries for AI inference across Loongson's compute chip lineup.
items.why_zh: 首个软件栈版本意味着国产自研GPU开始补齐编程模型与工具链生态，这是其能否被AI开发者真正采用的关键。
items.why_en: A first software stack version means China's in-house GPU is starting to fill in the programming model and toolchain ecosystem that determines real developer adoption.

items.title_zh: 小米MiMo-V2.6发布：超越Kimi K3、Qwen3.8 Max
items.title_en: Xiaomi Releases MiMo-V2.6, Claiming It Outperforms Kimi K3 and Qwen3.8 Max
items.summary_zh: 小米MiMo-V2.6发布：超越Kimi K3、Qwen3.8 Max t.cj.sina.cn
items.summary_en: Xiaomi has released MiMo-V2.6, claiming it outperforms Kimi K3 and Qwen3.8 Max. No benchmark details, scores, model size or availability information were provided.
items.why_zh: 小米以公开对标头部模型的方式宣示进展，反映国内大模型竞争正围绕性能排名持续升温。
items.why_en: Xiaomi's public comparison with leading models shows competition among Chinese LLMs is increasingly fought over performance rankings.

items.title_zh: 腾讯混元 Hy Image3.5 preview 发布：支持文生图与多轮对话创作，已上线元宝、ima 等应用
items.title_en: Tencent Hunyuan Releases Hy Image3.5 Preview: Text-to-Image and Multi-Turn Dialogue Creation, Live on Yuanbao and ima
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 22 日消息，腾讯混元团队今日宣布推出 Hy Image3.5 preview 模型。腾讯称该模型面向专业级生图创作，支持文生图、图生图和多轮对话创作。 腾讯称，该模型经过内部数百名专业设计师 GSB 盲测，对比 Hy Image3.0 提升 30%，与 Seedream 5.0 pro 持平，略优于 Nano-Banana Pro 和 Qwen-Image-3.0 Pro。 IT之家注：GSB 盲测是一种成对比较评测方法，评测者在不知道模型来源的情况下判断生成效果优劣。 腾讯表示，Hy Image3.5 preview 已在元宝 App 提前 2 个月逐步灰度上线和内测，生图整体请求量提升超过 50%。 定价方面，腾讯云 API 2K 图像定价为 0.15 元 / 张图，腾讯云国际版为 0.024 美元 / 张图，仅对输出图片收费。企业和开发者可通过腾讯云 TokenHub 调用 API。 目前，该模型已上线元宝、WorkRally、OnSolo、Miora、WorkBuddy、ima 等应用，并接入腾讯云媒体处理 MPS、云点播 VOD 平台。 元宝可免费使用人像编辑、智能 P 图、旅游规划图、知识信息图等场景，进入“创作”体验。ima 可通过 copilot 将知识库转为可视化网页、PPT 和图片。Miora、WorkRally、OnSolo 面向专业美学与…
items.summary_en: Tencent's Hunyuan team launched the Hy Image3.5 preview model, targeting professional image generation with text-to-image, image-to-image and multi-turn dialogue creation. Internal GSB blind tests with hundreds of designers show a 30% improvement over Hy Image3.0, on par with Seedream 5.0 Pro and slightly better than Nano-Banana Pro and Qwen-Image-3.0 Pro. It has been rolling out on the Yuanbao app for two months, lifting image requests by over 50%, and is priced at RMB 0.15 per 2K image via Tencent Cloud API.
items.why_zh: 腾讯以盲测对标竞品并快速落地多款应用，显示国产文生图模型能力与商业化提速。
items.why_en: Tencent's blind-test benchmarking and rapid app integration show accelerating capability and commercialization in domestic text-to-image models.

items.title_zh: 阿里平头哥将发布最强国产 AI 芯片真武 V900，算力提升 2 倍
items.title_en: Alibaba's T-Head to Launch 'Zhenwu V900,' Claimed Strongest Domestic AI Chip, Computing Power Up 2x
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 22 日消息，由阿里集团主办的 2026 云栖大会于 9 月 22 日至 24 日在杭州国际博览中心举行。 IT之家在大会现场获悉，本届云栖大会上， 阿里平头哥将发布最强国产 AI 芯片真武 V900，算力提升至真武 M890 的 3 倍 。基于它构建的单一集群可扩展至 50 万卡，可支撑前沿模型的训练和推理。 阿里表示，由于平头哥芯片产品线的成熟和客户的广泛应用， 预计年出货量将大幅提升 。 目前，平头哥已对数据中心芯片进行全面布局，包括真武系列 GPU、倚天系列 CPU、磐脉系列智能网卡，以及 ICN 互联芯片。组建超大规模 AI 集群所需的核心芯片已全面覆盖。 此外，阿里正在对芯片、服务器、超节点、网络、模型和推理系统进行联合调优， 提升整个 AI 集群的 Token 产能和效率 。自研的 M890AI 超节点已支撑超过 2 万亿参数大模型的高效推理，并在阿里云上实现规模化供给。 今年第四季度， 阿里云还将新增服务节点 ，进一步扩大超节点的供给规模。
items.summary_en: At the 2026 Yunqi Conference, Alibaba's T-Head will unveil the Zhenwu V900, claimed to be China's most powerful domestic AI chip, with computing power up to 3x that of Zhenwu M890 (the headline says 2x). A single cluster based on it can scale to 500,000 cards to support frontier model training and inference. T-Head has laid out Zhenwu GPUs, Yitian CPUs, Panmai smart NICs and ICN interconnect chips, while Alibaba is jointly tuning chips, servers, super nodes, networks, models and inference systems to boost token throughput.
items.why_zh: 真武 V900 与 50 万卡集群规划，显示国产 AI 芯片正加速追赶并支撑超大规模模型训练。
items.why_en: The Zhenwu V900 and 500,000-card cluster plan show domestic AI chips are catching up fast and enabling ultra-large-scale model training.

items.title_zh: 华为携手南方医院发布智慧医疗全球样板点，医疗AI 从单点突破走向体系化协同
items.title_en: Huawei and Nanfang Hospital Launch Global Smart Healthcare Flagship, Medical AI Moves from Point Breakthroughs to Systematic Collaboration
items.summary_zh: 华为携手南方医院发布智慧医疗全球样板点，医疗AI 从单点突破走向体系化协同 美通社
items.summary_en: Huawei and Nanfang Hospital released a global smart healthcare flagship site, framing medical AI as moving from isolated breakthroughs toward systematic collaboration. Public information so far covers mainly the launch and cooperation direction, without specific technical architecture, departments or deployment scale. The move signals a shift from standalone tools to cross-system coordination in healthcare AI.
items.why_zh: 医疗 AI 从单点工具走向体系化协同，是行业从试点迈向规模化落地的关键一步。
items.why_en: Moving from standalone tools to systematic collaboration is key for medical AI to scale beyond pilot projects.

items.title_zh: 阿里吴泳铭：全力投入 AI 基础设施建设，目标到 2032 年阿里云全球数据中心规模超 20GW
items.title_en: Alibaba's Wu Yongming: Full Commitment to AI Infrastructure, Aiming for 20GW+ Global Data Centers by 2032
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 22 日消息，IT之家今日在 2026 年云栖大会现场获悉，阿里巴巴 CEO 吴泳铭表示，当前客户 AI 需求非常强劲，将全力投入 AI 基础设施建设， 目标到 2032 年阿里云运营的全球数据中心规模超过 20GW 。 2026 云栖大会今日（9 月 22 日）上午在浙江杭州开幕， 英伟达位列本次大会巅峰合作伙伴，是本届云栖大会最高等级合作伙伴 。英特尔、AMD 分获钻石、红宝石合作伙伴。 阿里巴巴集团 CEO 吴泳铭、阿里千问 LLM 项目负责人刘大一恒等将在大会上发表主题演讲。今年云栖大会，云计算、AI、智能制造等众多国内外头部企业，多家算力、大模型产业链厂商集中亮相，算力生态合作成为本次云栖大会一大看点。 吴泳铭认为，今天机器动力已经承担了 99.9% 的物理工作，未来人类的思考总量还会继续增长，但机器思考将以更快的速度扩张，预期将会承担 99.9% 的思考工作。 顶级思考将从奢侈品变成可规模化供给的商品 ，每个细分领域都可以拥有上百万量级的 AI 科学家和专家，将给人类社会带来巨大的改变。 吴泳铭表示，AI 模型、AI 芯片和 AI 云是机器智能时代的三大基石，阿里巴巴将坚定投入这三项基础设施建设，这是阿里的长期战略选择。 在 2026 云栖大会上，阿里巴巴集团董事会主席蔡崇信表示，AI 发展已迈入全新阶段，正持续从前沿技术突破转向真实场景的规模化价值创…
items.summary_en: At the 2026 Yunqi Conference, Alibaba CEO Wu Yongming said customer AI demand is strong and the company will fully invest in AI infrastructure, targeting more than 20GW of Alibaba Cloud-operated global data centers by 2032. He called AI models, AI chips and AI cloud the three cornerstones of the machine intelligence era. He also predicted machines will handle 99.9% of thinking, turning top-tier thinking from a luxury into a scalable commodity.
items.why_zh: 20GW 目标显示中国云厂商的 AI 基建竞赛显著升级，算力供给成为长期战略核心。
items.why_en: The 20GW target shows a major escalation in Chinese cloud vendors' AI infrastructure race, making compute supply a core long-term strategy.

items.title_en: Alibaba's Wu Yongming: Full Investment in AI Infrastructure, Aiming for Over 20GW of Global Data Center Capacity by 2032

items.summary_en: At the 2026 Yunqi Conference, Alibaba CEO Wu Yongming said customer AI demand is strong and Alibaba will fully invest in AI infrastructure, aiming to operate over 20GW of global data center capacity by 2032. He called AI models, AI chips and AI cloud the three cornerstones of the machine intelligence era, predicting machines will handle 99.9% of thinking in the future.

items.title_zh: 我国活跃智能体已近 500 万个，到 2030 年中国 AI 算力市场规模或暴增 300%

items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 22 日消息，据央视新闻报道，《2026 年中国人工智能计算力发展评估报告》已于昨日发布。报告显示，随着智能体技术走向成熟，2026—2030 年，中国活跃智能体复合年均增长率将超 150%。 报告显示，人工智能正完成从内容生成到任务执行的转变，全球活跃智能体数量将从 2026 年的 7940 万个增长至 2030 年的 22.16 亿个。2026 年，中国活跃智能体已近 500 万个（达到 495 万个），据预测，2030 年将增长到 1.97 亿个，复合年均增长率达到 151.2%。 值得一提的是，支撑人工智能应用的算力，其投资规模也在加速扩张：2030 年，全球人工智能算力市场规模预计将达到 1.25 万亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 8.39 万亿元人民币） 。 其中，中国市场将达到 1,501 亿美元 （现汇率约合 1.01 万亿元人民币） ，均为 2025 年的 4 倍 。
items.summary_en: CCTV reported on the 2026 China AI Computing Power Development Assessment Report, which says AI is shifting from content generation to task execution as agent technology matures. China's active agents are projected to grow from 4.95 million in 2026 to 197 million by 2030, a CAGR above 150%, while global active agents rise from 79.4 million to 2.216 billion. Global AI computing market size is expected to reach $1.25 trillion by 2030, with China at $150.1 billion, four times 2025 levels.
items.why_zh: 智能体数量与算力市场同步爆发，为 AI 基础设施投资和产业布局提供了量化依据。
items.why_en: The simultaneous explosion in agents and computing market size provides a quantified basis for AI infrastructure investment and industry planning.

items.title_en: AI Coding Platform Bitrig Adds Apple iPhone Duo Support With Interactive 3D Simulator
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 22 日消息，据外媒 9to5Mac 报道，随着苹果上周发布 Xcode 27.1 Beta 1 并加入 iPhone Duo 应用开发支持，如今一款 AI 编程平台 Bitrig 也宣布支持构建和测试 iPhone Duo 应用。 据介绍，Bitrig 最初是一款面向“氛围编程”（vibe coding）的应用，用户可以通过文字或语音提示生成原生 SwiftUI 应用，并直接在 iPhone 上的 Bitrig 应用中运行。此后，该平台不断扩展功能，推出 Mac 版应用，加入完整的 Xcode 工具链、内置 iPhone 模拟器以及真机测试功能，同时支持将项目导出至 Xcode，或通过 TestFlight 和 App Store 进行分发。 在苹果 发布 Xcode 27.1 Beta 1，正式支持构建和测试 iPhone Duo 应用 后，Bitrig 也迅速加入相关支持，目前提供了一套交互式 3D 模拟器。开发者可以在模拟器中自由折叠、倾斜、旋转和调整设备姿态，以测试应用在不同使用场景下的表现。 针对 iPhone Duo 的铰链交互，开发者可以使用 SwiftUI 中的 onHingeChange 来根据设备折叠状态调整应用的交互和视觉效果，Bitrig 模拟器可以实时读取铰链数据，帮助开发者测试设备从闭合到展开过程中的应用响应。 Bitrig 还支持利…
items.summary_en: After Apple released Xcode 27.1 Beta 1 with official support for building and testing iPhone Duo apps, AI coding platform Bitrig quickly followed suit, adding iPhone Duo support along with an interactive 3D simulator. Developers can fold, tilt and rotate the virtual device to test how apps behave, and use SwiftUI's onHingeChange with real-time hinge data to adapt interactions as the device moves from closed to unfolded. Bitrig began as a vibe-coding app that generates native SwiftUI apps from text or voice prompts, and has since added a Mac app, a full Xcode toolchain, built-in simulators, device testing and distribution via Xcode, TestFlight or the App Store.
items.why_zh: 折叠屏设备带来全新的铰链交互形态，AI 编程平台第一时间补齐模拟与调试能力，意味着开发者无需等待硬件即可为新形态做适配。
items.why_en: Foldable devices introduce a new hinge-based interaction model, and an AI coding platform moving early to support simulation and debugging lets developers adapt to the new form factor without waiting for hardware.
