items.title_en: Inspur Unveils Yuannao SD200 Ultra Supernode: Runs 2.8T-Parameter Kimi K3 on One Machine With 5.85ms Token Latency
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 22 日消息，在昨日的 2026 人工智能计算大会（AICC2026）上，浪潮信息宣布推出元脑 SD200 Ultra 超节点 AI 服务器与元脑 HC2000 多元算力机组。 据官方介绍，元脑 SD200 Ultra 基于国产 AI 芯片打造，单机可承载运行 2.8 万亿参数的 Kimi K3 大模型。 浪潮表示，SD200 Ultra 的 Token 生成时延首次降至 5.85 毫秒以内，相当于单用户速度 170 Tokens/s，达到业界平均水平的 5 倍。该机型支持 10 万亿参数规模前沿模型单机运行。 IT之家注：Token 生成时延指大模型每输出一个词元所需的平均时间，是衡量推理响应速度的核心指标之一。 SD200 Ultra 采用 3D Hyper Mesh 架构，紧耦合 128 芯本土 AI 芯片，提供 8TB 统一编址显存和 64TB 内存。系统采用原生内存语义通信，通信时延低至 0.69 微秒。 该超节点通过全局统一编址、虚拟影子设备映射、跨域地址翻译与路由，实现 GPU 跨主机域的统一寻址访问，构建百纳秒级低时延内存语义互连域。 浪潮称，借助对称内存技术，SD200 Ultra 首次在基于本土 AI 芯片的超节点上实现 GPU 显存直连，使 GPU 可直接访问远端 GPU 显存。AllReduce 通信时间降低 3.5 倍。 针对 Kimi…
items.summary_en: At AICC2026, Inspur launched the Yuannao SD200 Ultra supernode AI server and the Yuannao HC2000 multi-compute unit. Inspur says the SD200 Ultra, built on domestic AI chips, can run the 2.8-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 model on a single machine with token generation latency under 5.85 milliseconds — about 170 tokens/s per user, which it claims is five times the industry average — and can host frontier models with up to 10 trillion parameters. It uses a 3D Hyper Mesh architecture tightly coupling 128 domestic AI chips, 8TB of unified-addressed VRAM and 64TB of memory, with native memory-semantic communication as low as 0.69 microseconds, and claims the first GPU direct memory access on a domestic-chip supernode, cutting AllReduce time by 3.5x.
items.why_zh: 超节点推理时延与单机可承载模型规模，直接决定大模型服务成本与响应体验，也反映国产算力在互连与内存语义技术上的进展。
items.why_en: Supernode inference latency and the model size a single machine can host directly shape large-model serving costs and responsiveness, and signal progress in domestic compute, interconnect and memory-semantic technologies.

items.title_zh: 小米 MiMo-V2.6 发布：Pro 与 Flash 双版本价格不变，超越 Kimi K3、GLM-5.3 成为当前 AA 指数排名最高的开源模型
items.title_en: Xiaomi Releases Open-Source MiMo-V2.6 in Pro and Flash Variants, Topping Open-Weight AA Index
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 22 日消息，小米今日凌晨正式发布并开源了全新的 Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6 系列，包含 Pro 与 Flash 两个原生全模态模型。 小米称这是其探索 RSI（递归自我改进）路径的关键一步，通过规模化扩展强化学习算力，让模型在持续的探索与反馈中拓展智能边界。 得益于 RL 算力的扩展，MiMo-V2.6-Pro 在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index（AA 综合智能指数）v4.3.2 中取得 46 分，超过 Kimi K3（44 分）和 GLM-5.3（45 分），成为当前 AA 指数上排名最高的开源权重模型，较其前代 MiMo-V2.5-Pro 的 26 分高出 20 分。 小米官方同时说明，该模型与 Claude Fable 5.1 和 GPT-6 Astra（均为 53 分）等顶级闭源模型相比仍有差距。 在 RL 训练阶段，MiMo-V2.6 可能是目前国产开源模型中投入 RL 算力最多的模型之一。Pro 与 Flash 训练历时不到 6 天，成本分别约 262 万美元与 85 万美元，各完成 30 步，累计约 75 万条轨迹。 训练任务平均通过率分别相对提升 25% 和 12%，样本外的长程软件工程评测基准 DeepSWE v1.1 分别提升约 17 分（48.8 至 65.7）和约 14 分（58.4 至…
items.summary_en: Xiaomi has open-sourced its MiMo-V2.6 series, comprising the native omni-modal Pro and Flash models. MiMo-V2.6-Pro scored 46 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3.2, surpassing Kimi K3 and GLM-5.3 to become the highest-ranked open-weight model, though it still trails top closed models at 53. Training took under six days at roughly $2.62M (Pro) and $0.85M (Flash), with gains on the DeepSWE v1.1 benchmark.
items.why_zh: 小米以较低训练成本把开源权重模型推到 AA 指数开源第一，显示开源阵营在强化学习算力投入上的追赶速度。
items.why_en: Xiaomi's low-cost training run puts an open-weight model at the top of the open-source AA rankings, signaling how fast open models are closing the gap.

items.title_zh: 马斯克 SpaceXAI 发布旗下最强编码和知识处理模型 Grok 4.7，百万词元输入 2 美元起
items.title_en: SpaceXAI Launches Grok 4.7 for Coding and Knowledge Work, From $2 per Million Input Tokens
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 22 日消息，SpaceXAI 今日宣布推出新一代 Grok 4.7，主打编程和知识工作场景。 官方称其采用全新更大规模基础模型，并通过更长时间的强化学习训练提升复杂任务处理能力，是该公司目前最强的编码和知识处理模型 —— 速度是同类模型的两倍，价格却只有一半。 如前所述，Grok 4.7 针对编程和知识工作进行了优化。与 Grok 4.6 相比，新模型能够在困难任务上持续更长时间，并加强了对自身输出结果的检查能力。 在 CursorBench 4.0 测试中，Grok 4.7 面向长时间运行的编程任务，在价格与性能方面处于同类模型的前列。官方同时表示，该模型的运行速度和定价与 Grok 4.6 相同。 Grok 4.7 使用了比 Grok 4.6 更大的基座模型，并接受了更长时间的强化学习训练。训练数据更加侧重需要数小时完成的复杂任务，同时针对模型的自我验证和长上下文管理能力进行了优化。 SpaceXAI 还针对 Grok Bot harness 对 Grok 4.7 进行了原生训练，使其在对话以及一般知识工作任务中的表现得到提升。此外，该模型在文档和演示文稿生成方面也有所改进。 在 GDPval 和 AA Briefcase 两项基准测试中，Grok 4.7 均较 Grok 4.6 有所提升。这些测试要求 AI 完成律师、护士、金融分析师等专业人士日常工作中的…
items.summary_en: SpaceXAI unveiled Grok 4.7, targeting coding and knowledge work with a larger base model and longer reinforcement learning. The company claims it is twice as fast as comparable models at half the price, starting at $2 per million input tokens, with gains over Grok 4.6 on CursorBench 4.0, GDPval and AA Briefcase.
items.why_zh: 在编码与专业工作这一高价值场景中，Grok 4.7 以“更快更便宜”为卖点直接参与与主流模型的性价比竞争。
items.why_en: Grok 4.7 competes on speed and price in coding and professional knowledge work, a high-value battleground for frontier models.

items.title_zh: 霍楚尔宣布新一轮 AI 监管措施
items.title_en: Hochul announces new round of AI regulations
items.summary_zh: 据 nny360.com 报道，霍楚尔（Hochul）宣布将推出新一轮人工智能监管措施。目前公开信息仅涉及这一表态本身，报道未披露监管的具体适用范围、执行时间表或约束对象等细节。该消息意味着州层面正在继续推进对 AI 的规范治理。
items.summary_en: Hochul announces new round of AI regulations nny360.com
items.why_zh: 州级监管的持续加码，可能影响 AI 企业在当地的产品部署与合规成本。
items.why_en: Continued state-level rulemaking could shape deployment and compliance costs for AI companies operating locally.

items.title_zh: FAA launches AI tool to assist air traffic control at major D.C.-area airports
items.title_en: FAA launches AI tool to assist air traffic control at major D.C.-area airports
items.summary_zh: FAA launches AI tool to assist air traffic control at major D.C.-area airports The Washington Post
items.summary_en: The FAA has launched an AI tool to assist air traffic control at major airports in the D.C. area, according to The Washington Post. Details on its capabilities, scope, and operational status were not provided in the available report. The move signals growing regulatory interest in applying AI to critical aviation operations.
items.why_zh: 若 AI 进入空管等安全关键环节，将直接影响航空安全与效率，FAA 的部署具有示范意义。
items.why_en: It marks a high-stakes test of AI in safety-critical air traffic operations and could shape future aviation regulation.

items.title_zh: NVIDIA Launches DSX Ready to Qualify Power and Cooling Products for AI Factories
items.title_en: NVIDIA Launches DSX Ready to Qualify Power and Cooling Products for AI Factories
items.summary_zh: NVIDIA Launches DSX Ready to Qualify Power and Cooling Products for AI Factories blogs.nvidia.com
items.summary_en: NVIDIA introduced DSX Ready, a program to qualify power and cooling products for AI factories, aiming to set a reference standard for the electrical and thermal infrastructure of large-scale AI data centers.
items.why_zh: 随着 AI 数据中心功耗与散热压力飙升，供电与制冷正成为算力扩张的关键瓶颈，英伟达试图通过认证体系主导这一环节。
items.why_en: Power and cooling are emerging bottlenecks for AI compute expansion, and NVIDIA is seeking to set the qualifying standard for that layer.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 和 OpenAI 在 IPO 前应对 AI 监管
items.title_en: Anthropic and OpenAI navigate AI regulation ahead of IPOs
items.summary_zh: 据 Investing.com 报道，Anthropic 和 OpenAI 正在筹备首次公开募股（IPO）之际，积极应对人工智能监管。报道没有披露两家公司具体的上市时间表、与监管机构的沟通细节或估值信息。随着领先 AI 公司走向公开市场，合规和监管风险正成为影响其上市进程与投资者预期的关键因素。对 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 而言，如何在满足监管要求的同时保持增长，将是 IPO 阶段的重要挑战。
items.summary_en: Anthropic and OpenAI navigate AI regulation ahead of IPOs Investing.com
items.why_zh: AI 巨头在 IPO 前如何适应监管，将影响其估值、投资者信心和行业合规标准。
items.why_en: How AI leaders handle regulation before going public could shape investor confidence and industry-wide compliance standards.

items.title_zh: 盖茨基金会发起联盟，为 AI 构建更具代表性的语言数据集
items.title_en: Gates Foundation launches coalition to build more representative language data sets for AI
items.summary_zh: 盖茨基金会宣布发起一个联盟，目标是构建更具代表性的语言数据集，供人工智能开发使用。该消息由 Audacy 报道。现有信息没有披露联盟成员、资金规模或数据集将覆盖哪些语言。此举旨在改善 AI 语言数据中可能存在的代表性不足问题，推动更包容、更适用于不同地区和人群的 AI 系统。语言数据的多样性和质量，正被视为影响模型公平性与性能的基础要素。
items.summary_en: Gates Foundation launches coalition to build more representative language data sets for AI Audacy
items.why_zh: 语言数据代表性直接影响 AI 的公平性与全球适用性，尤其关乎欠代表性语言和人群。
items.why_en: More inclusive language data can reduce bias and improve AI performance across diverse populations and languages.

items.title_zh: 智谱AI编程工具被曝将用户核心资产打包传走，但传了564次都失败！该产品用户达200多万，公司再回应：已正式开源，交由社区监督
items.title_en: Zhipu AI coding tool accused of trying to transfer users' core assets; all 564 attempts failed, company open-sources it
items.summary_zh: 智谱AI编程工具被曝将用户核心资产打包传走，但传了564次都失败！该产品用户达200多万，公司再回应：已正式开源，交由社区监督 mrjjxw.com
items.summary_en: A Zhipu AI coding tool was accused of packaging and trying to transmit users' core assets, but the 564 attempts reportedly all failed. The product has over 2 million users, and Zhipu has responded that it is now officially open-sourced and subject to community oversight. The report did not specify what the "core assets" were or how the issue was discovered.
items.why_zh: 事件涉及 AI 编程工具的数据安全与用户信任，开源和监督成为公司回应争议的方式。
items.why_en: It raises concerns about data security and user trust in AI coding tools, and highlights open-source oversight as a response.

items.title_zh: 比利时 Aikido 推出网络安全 AI 模型，本地化工具需求上升
items.title_en: Belgium's Aikido launches cybersecurity AI model as demand for local tools grows
items.summary_zh: 据路透社报道，比利时公司 Aikido 推出了一款网络安全 AI 模型，以回应市场对本地化工具日益增长的需求。现有信息未披露该模型的具体功能、性能指标或部署方式。此举反映出在欧洲等市场，数据主权和本地化网络安全解决方案正受到更多关注。随着企业对数据合规和本地部署的要求提高，专注于本地市场的网络安全 AI 工具可能迎来更大需求。
items.summary_en: Belgium's Aikido launches cybersecurity AI model as demand for local tools grows Reuters
items.why_zh: 本地化网络安全 AI 可帮助企业满足数据合规和主权要求，也反映出区域 AI 工具市场的增长。
items.why_en: It highlights the growing market for local cybersecurity AI that meets data sovereignty and compliance needs.

items.title_zh: 智谱上线零数据留存机制
items.title_en: Zhipu launches zero data retention mechanism
items.summary_zh: 智谱上线零数据留存机制 新浪财经
items.summary_en: Zhipu has launched a zero data retention mechanism, according to Sina Finance. The available report did not specify which products or services it covers or how it is implemented. Such a mechanism is typically aimed at addressing user data privacy concerns.
items.why_zh: 在 AI 数据安全争议背景下，零数据留存有助于回应用户隐私关切并重建信任。
items.why_en: It may help rebuild trust amid growing scrutiny over how AI companies handle user data.

items.title_zh: John Ternus 能找到苹果的下一个大产品吗？
items.title_en: Can John Ternus find Apple’s next big thing?
items.summary_zh: 在一档播客访谈中，主持人对话彭博社首席苹果记者 Mark Gurman，讨论苹果新任 CEO John Ternus 能否为苹果找到下一个重大产品。此前，苹果举办了年度 iPhone 硬件发布会，这是 Ternus 接替前 CEO Tim Cook 后不到两周内的首场重大产品发布。发布会还推出了苹果首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo。访谈围绕这些事件及其时间点展开，探讨苹果在新领导层下的产品方向。
items.summary_en: Today, I’m talking with Mark Gurman, who is the world’s best-sourced Apple reporter — both as Bloomberg ’s chief Apple correspondent and the host of the upcoming podcast Power On . Earlier this month, Apple hosted its annual iPhone hardware event, virtually every detail of which was reported ahead of time by Mark. But this event was special, for a number of reasons. It was new Apple CEO John Ternus’ first major product launch since he took over for former CEO Tim Cook less than two weeks prior. It was also the debut of the iPhone Duo, Apple’s first foldable smartphone. The timing of those two…
items.why_zh: 苹果新 CEO 的首场发布会与首款折叠屏手机，可能决定苹果未来产品方向。
items.why_en: Apple's new CEO and its first foldable mark a critical moment for the company's next product era.

items.title_zh: 软银启动 110 亿美元债券发售，为投资 OpenAI 筹资
items.title_en: SoftBank launches $11 billion bond sale to fund OpenAI investment
items.summary_zh: 据 Yahoo Finance 报道，软银启动规模 110 亿美元的债券发售，所筹资金将用于对 OpenAI 的投资。现有信息未披露债券的具体条款、投资者构成或投资 OpenAI 的具体安排。此举显示软银继续加码人工智能领域，并通过债务融资支持其 AI 投资布局。在 AI 竞争加剧的背景下，软银对 OpenAI 的这笔投资及其融资方式受到市场关注。
items.summary_en: SoftBank launches $11 billion bond sale to fund OpenAI investment Yahoo Finance
items.why_zh: 软银巨额发债投资 OpenAI，凸显 AI 资本竞赛的规模以及背后的融资风险。
items.why_en: It highlights the scale of capital and risk in the race to fund leading AI companies.

items.title_zh: 智谱AI编程工具ZCode被曝偷传用户数据至境外，律师呼吁监管介入调查
items.title_en: Zhipu AI's Coding Tool ZCode Accused of Sending User Data Overseas, Lawyers Call for Regulatory Probe
items.summary_zh: 智谱AI编程工具ZCode被曝偷传用户数据至境外，律师呼吁监管介入调查 虎嗅网
items.summary_en: Zhipu AI's coding tool ZCode has been accused of secretly transmitting user data overseas, prompting lawyers to call for a regulatory investigation. The case spotlights data-security and privacy-compliance concerns around AI coding assistants.
items.why_zh: AI编程工具会接触大量代码与企业数据，一旦涉及数据跨境，可能触及合规红线并影响用户信任。
items.why_en: AI coding tools handle sensitive code and enterprise data, so cross-border transfers could breach compliance rules and erode user trust.

items.title_zh: 谷歌携五大 PC 厂商正式推出首批 Googlebook 笔记本，起售价 899 美元
items.title_en: Google and Five PC Makers Launch First Googlebook Laptops, Starting at $899
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 21 日消息，谷歌及其合作伙伴终于正式发布全新 Googlebook 产品线的首批笔记本电脑，搭载基于安卓技术栈构建、底层源自 Chrome OS 的 Googlebook OS 系统。首批一共五款机型，分别来自宏碁、华硕、戴尔、惠普以及联想。即日起开启预售，10 月 4 日正式上架销售。 产品起售价区间为 899 美元 （现汇率约合 6,028 元人民币） ‑1,299 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 8,709 元人民币） ，定价直接对标 MacBook Air 以及众多 Windows 轻薄本。每一台 Googlebook 均附赠 12 个月的 Google AI Pro 会员以及 5TB 云存储空间；另外还包含 YouTube Premium、Adobe Photoshop、剪映专业版（CapCut）三个月试用权益。谷歌承诺为本系列笔记本提供最长 10 年系统更新支持。 以下是各款 Googlebook 的硬件规格以及横向对比： 宏碁 Acer Googlebook 14 首发五款当中唯一一款可翻转二合一机型；设计思路近似 Acer Chromebook Plus Spin 714。官方标称续航最长 16 小时。它当前起售价最低：899 美元 （现汇率约合 6,028 元人民币） 。不过该价格属于限时首发价。宏碁的 Kelly Odle 在接受 The V…
items.summary_en: Google and partners Acer, Asus, Dell, HP and Lenovo have unveiled the first five Googlebook laptops, running Googlebook OS built on Android tech with Chrome OS roots. Pre-orders are open now ahead of an October 4 launch, priced from $899 to $1,299 against MacBook Air and Windows ultrabooks, with 12 months of Google AI Pro, 5TB storage and up to 10 years of updates.
items.why_zh: 这是谷歌以安卓底层重构PC操作系统、并把AI订阅打包进硬件的关键一步，将直接冲击Windows与Mac的轻薄本市场。
items.why_en: It marks Google's biggest push to rebuild PC software on an Android base while bundling AI subscriptions with hardware, directly challenging Windows and Mac ultrabooks.

items.title_zh: 智谱回应数据隐私争议：ZCode将正式开源，MaaS平台将上线数据内容不留存功能
items.title_en: Zhipu Responds to Data Privacy Concerns: ZCode to Be Open-Sourced, No-Retention Option Coming to MaaS
items.summary_zh: 智谱回应数据隐私争议：ZCode将正式开源，MaaS平台将上线数据内容不留存功能 新浪财经
items.summary_en: Zhipu has responded to data privacy concerns by pledging to formally open-source ZCode and to add a no-data-retention option to its MaaS platform, aiming to address user worries about how code and API data are handled.
items.why_zh: 数据留存政策正成为企业选用大模型 API 的核心顾虑，厂商以开源和不留存承诺来争夺信任。
items.why_en: Data retention is a decisive concern for enterprises choosing model APIs, making transparency pledges a competitive lever.

items.title_zh: 智谱回应数据隐私争议：ZCode将正式开源，MaaS平台将上线数据内容不留存功能
items.title_en: Zhipu Responds to Data Privacy Controversy: ZCode to Go Open Source, MaaS Platform to Stop Retaining Data
items.summary_zh: 智谱回应数据隐私争议：ZCode将正式开源，MaaS平台将上线数据内容不留存功能 finance.sina.cn
items.summary_en: Zhipu has responded to a data privacy controversy by announcing that its ZCode coding tool will be officially open-sourced and that its MaaS platform will add a feature that does not retain user data content. The moves are seen as an effort to rebuild user trust.
items.why_zh: 数据隐私是AI企业赢得用户信任的关键，智谱的整改方式或将成为行业参考。
items.why_en: Data privacy is central to user trust in AI companies, and Zhipu's fix could set a precedent for the industry.

items.title_zh: Samsone：面向端侧推理的开源小型音频语言模型家族
items.title_en: Samsone: A Family of Open Small Audio Language Models for On-Device Inference
items.summary_zh: 一篇arXiv论文提出Samsone家族的小型音频语言模型（SALMs），面向边缘计算与端侧推理场景。随着大型音频语言模型参数规模突破数十亿，隐私保护与低延迟需求推动研究转向可在设备本地运行的小模型。论文称其核心模型Samsone-134M在多个基准上刷新了同参数规模的最优表现，并进一步探讨了SALM的缩放规律。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21666v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The success of Large Audio Language Models has driven the development of massive multimodal networks exceeding billions of parameters. However, the demand for privacy-preserving, low-latency processing has shifted focus toward Small Audio Language Models (SALMs) capable of on-device execution. In this paper, we introduce Samsone, a family of SALMs designed for edge computing. Our core model, Samsone-134M, establishes a new state-of-the-art for its size class across multiple benchmarks. We further explore the scaling laws of SALMs by introducing…
items.why_zh: 它说明音频大模型正朝端侧小型化演进，在隐私与低延迟需求下，小参数模型可能比超大模型更实用。
items.why_en: It shows audio AI shifting toward compact on-device models, where privacy and low latency can matter more than raw parameter count.

items.title_zh: 转录组模型预测免疫治疗响应：跨队列泛化能力有限
items.title_en: Transcriptomic Models for Immunotherapy Response Prediction Show Limited Cross-cohort Generalisability
items.summary_zh: 一篇arXiv论文系统评估了基于转录组的免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）响应预测模型。免疫检查点抑制剂已改变肿瘤治疗格局，但相当比例患者存在原发或获得性耐药，因此治疗前的准确响应预测仍是未满足的临床需求。基于bulk与单细胞RNA测序的转录组生物标志物被视为捕捉肿瘤—免疫互作的有前景路径，但论文对九种先进模型进行基准测试后发现，其跨队列泛化能力仍然有限。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2604.05478v5 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) have transformed cancer therapy; yet substantial proportion of patients exhibit intrinsic or acquired resistance, making accurate pre-treatment response prediction a critical unmet need. Transcriptomics-based biomarkers derived from bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) offer a promising avenue for capturing tumour-immune interactions, yet the cross-cohort generalisability of existing prediction models remains unclear.We systematically benchmark nine state-of-the-art transcriptomic ICI respo…
items.why_zh: 它提醒临床AI模型的真实价值取决于跨人群泛化能力，否则难以可靠指导免疫治疗决策。
items.why_en: It warns that the clinical value of AI biomarkers hinges on cross-cohort generalisability, without which they cannot reliably guide immunotherapy decisions.

items.title_zh: 大模型有多烧钱？智谱年内融资756亿，市值缩水万亿遭遇价值重估
items.title_en: Report: Zhipu Raised 75.6B Yuan This Year as Valuation Writedown Fuels Rethink
items.summary_zh: 大模型有多烧钱？智谱年内融资756亿，市值缩水万亿遭遇价值重估 财富号
items.summary_en: A piece published on a self-media account claims Zhipu raised 75.6 billion yuan this year while its valuation saw a trillion-scale writedown, framing the tension between heavy AI spending and returns. The figures come from a self-media source without disclosed methodology.
items.why_zh: 融资与估值的一升一降，折射出资本市场对大模型高投入、慢回报模式的态度正在转变。
items.why_en: Rising funding alongside falling valuations reflects shifting investor sentiment toward the costly, slow-return economics of large models.

items.title_zh: 智谱回应数据隐私争议：ZCode将正式开源，MaaS平台将上线数据内容不留存功能
items.title_en: Zhipu Responds to Data Privacy Row: ZCode to Be Open-Sourced, MaaS Platform to Stop Retaining Data
items.summary_zh: 智谱回应数据隐私争议：ZCode将正式开源，MaaS平台将上线数据内容不留存功能 新浪财经
items.summary_en: Responding to the data-privacy controversy around its coding tool ZCode, Zhipu said ZCode will be fully open-sourced and its MaaS platform will add a feature that does not retain user data content. The move aims to address concerns over data security and privacy.
items.why_zh: 开源与“不留存”承诺是厂商重建信任的具体手段，也反映AI服务的数据合规正成为行业硬约束。
items.why_en: Open-sourcing and no-retention pledges are concrete ways vendors rebuild trust, signalling that data compliance is becoming a hard requirement for AI services.

items.summary_zh: 据 CNBC 报道，阿里巴巴在公布新一代 AI 芯片和数据中心扩建计划后，股价出现大涨。此举显示阿里正进一步加码 AI 基础设施与自研芯片，试图在算力自主和云服务上建立优势。市场积极反应也表明投资者看好其 AI 战略的落地前景，相关计划的具体规模与时间表尚未在报道中详述。
items.summary_en: Alibaba shares jump as new AI chip, data center buildout plans unveiled cnbc.com
items.why_zh: 股价大涨说明市场认可阿里自研 AI 芯片与数据中心扩张的长期价值。
items.why_en: The share jump shows investors endorse the long-term value of Alibaba's self-developed AI chips and data center expansion.

items.summary_en: Alibaba's chip unit T-Head has released what it calls the most powerful domestic AI chip, according to Tonghuashun, sending Alibaba shares moving. The chip marks a notable step in Alibaba's self-developed computing efforts.
items.why_zh: 平头哥最强国产 AI 芯片发布，凸显阿里在自研算力上的突破与国产替代意义。
items.why_en: T-Head's most powerful domestic AI chip highlights Alibaba's self-developed computing breakthrough and import-substitution significance.

items.summary_zh: 豆包手机发售 AI代理进入终端竞赛 AI决策透明度成焦点 中华网
items.summary_en: Doubao Phone has officially gone on sale, signaling that competition among AI agents is extending from the cloud to terminal devices. According to Chinanet, as AI agents land on phones and other terminals, the transparency of AI decision-making has become a key focus. The shift highlights the accelerating deployment of on-device AI agents and the growing importance of explainability and trust.
items.why_zh: AI 代理从云端走向终端，意味着 AI 将更直接地参与用户日常决策，其透明度与可信度成为产品能否被接受的关键。
items.why_en: As AI agents move from the cloud to terminals, they will participate more directly in users' daily decisions, making transparency and trust key to adoption.

items.why_en: The deep collaboration between a traditional automaker and an AI platform to launch an AI-native vehicle signals that automotive intelligence is entering an 'AI-native' phase.

items.why_en: Doubao's cockpit assistant debuting in a production car is a notable signal of LLMs entering smart vehicles.

items.summary_en: Sina Mobile discusses security concerns amid the rapid rise of AI coding. As AI coding tools accelerate development, they may also introduce vulnerabilities, data leaks, or supply-chain risks. The article asks whether security governance can keep pace with widespread adoption.
items.why_zh: AI 编程提效的同时，安全风险可能被放大，值得开发者和企业警惕。
items.why_en: As AI coding boosts productivity, it may amplify security risks, warranting caution from developers and enterprises.

items.title_zh: 千问 AI 眼镜 N1 系列亮相阿里云栖大会：支持眼动追踪与虹膜支付，10 月 13 日发售
items.title_en: Qwen AI Glasses N1 Series Debuts at Yunqi Conference with Eye Tracking and Iris Payment, On Sale October 13
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 22 日消息，阿里巴巴“2026 云栖大会”于 9 月 22 日-24 日在杭州举行，IT之家亲临现场，将为大家持续带来相关报道。 除了一系列软件成果之外，阿里还展示了其新一代全系列千问 AI 硬件产品，包含千问 AI 眼镜 N1、N1 Pro 及千问 AI 耳夹式耳机。三款新品已开启线上预约，并将于 10 月 13 日现货发售。 据官方介绍，N1 系列搭载 5000 万像素传感器，支持第一视角拍摄。其中，N1 Pro 支持眼动追踪和虹膜支付。用户看向展品并提问时，AI 可借助视线信息判断用户所指对象。 另一款新品千问 AI 耳夹式耳机结合 Bose 调音与 AI 助理能力，支持面对面翻译、AI 听记和语音办事。 千问 AI 硬件总经理宋刚表示，AI 穿戴是千问的重要载体，也是 Personal Agent 的核心组成部分。通过持续感知真实场景，推动 AI 从等待指令走向主动服务。 他表示，千问正以 Personal Agent 的形态加速演化。穿戴硬件可在获取用户授权的前提下，通过第一视角感知和语音交互，构建以个人为中心的多终端 Context，并随时提供服务。 京东 千问 AI 智能眼镜 N1 【新品上市预约】 4K 旗舰影像 LivePhoto 健康监测 AI 助手主动提醒听歌拍照翻译 待发布 直达链接
items.summary_en: At Alibaba's Yunqi Conference in Hangzhou, the company unveiled the Qwen AI Glasses N1 and N1 Pro plus a Qwen AI clip-on earbud, all opening for online reservations and going on sale October 13. The N1 series features a 50MP sensor for first-person capture, while the N1 Pro adds eye tracking and iris payment.
items.why_zh: 这显示阿里正把千问从软件推向可穿戴硬件，以 Personal Agent 形态争夺下一代个人 AI 入口。
items.why_en: It shows Alibaba pushing Qwen from software into wearables, competing for the next-generation personal AI entry point through Personal Agents.

items.summary_en: Alibaba has introduced a portfolio of AI chips aimed at powering large-scale data centers, signaling a continued push into in-house silicon. The move is intended to strengthen its computing supply and support its cloud and model businesses.

items.why_en: Commercializing in-house AI chips matters for Alibaba Cloud's computing autonomy and the cost and supply of large-scale model training.
